  • Success implementing multiple sourcing strategies.
  • Advanced negotiation skills.
  • Proven ability to deliver results in challenging environments.
  • Strong leadership skills: the ability to quickly build a working rapport and level of influence with executive level management.

This position must be an independent thinker, have strong executive presence, demonstrate creativity for unique/unknown client requests, manage both strategic and tactical details, and have extraordinary problem-solving skills to never allow a roadblock to stop them.

description:

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

Base Salary: $80,000 to $110,000 per year

MUST HAVE

  • Proven success profitably scaling new and existing brands on YouTube.
  • Strong analytical skills with proficiency in BI tools (Looker, Google Analytics, etc.) and advanced Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, regression analysis, correlation, etc).
  • Strong understanding of best practices that drive high-performing creatives, including YouTube ABCDs, briefs, and collaborating on video production with creative teams.
  • Demonstrated experience owning P&L and hitting aggressive growth + profitability goals, and building best practice playbooks.
  • Exceptional collaboration and proactive communication skills; comfortable presenting insights both written and verbal, and influencing decision-making across teams.

EXPERIENCE

6+ years managing and scaling a YouTube performance-based portfolio, with budgets of $20M+/year.

YOUR ROLE

You are a YouTube performance marketing expert who will take full ownership of Launch Potato’s YouTube business. This is a career-defining opportunity: you’ll be responsible for significantly scaling one of our most important growth channels while maintaining profitability.

You’ll combine hands-on campaign management with high-level strategy, directly owning campaign execution, P&L, and growth targets. From testing new creatives to developing playbooks, you’ll push the limits of what’s possible in YouTube performance marketing, and over time, expand into other verticals performance video platforms.

This role has a clear growth path to leading performance video across brands and verticals within Launch Potato’s portfolio.

OUTCOMES (PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS)

  • Take full ownership of campaign performance, pacing, reporting, operations, setup, and P&L for Insurance YouTube campaigns.
  • Deliver consistent growth in spend and profitability, reaching a 2x annualized run rate in year one at a minimum of 110% ROAS .
  • Provide actionable insights and recommendations to stakeholders, backed by rigorous data insights, reporting, and analysis.
  • Drive measurable improvements in CTR, CVR, ROAS, and margin through ongoing creative testing and iteration.
  • Collaborate with the creative team on video production, advocating for what your campaigns need to succeed.
  • Expand YouTube campaigns into new insurance and other financial services verticals to drive incremental revenue and expand the portfolio.
  • Share best practices and insights across the Paid Media team to strengthen YouTube performance in other verticals.
  • Build and lead a video-first performance marketing and paid media team to support execution as investment scales.
  • Work with internal stakeholders, and external vendors to creatively build net new audiences that target high value customers.

SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • You consistently scale YouTube while maintaining profitability.
  • You set the standard for extreme ownership and operational excellence.
  • You generate learnings that push the entire paid media team forward.
  • You become the go-to internal expert for video-first performance marketing.
  • You lay the foundation for a high-performing video team under your leadership.

COMPETENCIES

  • Technical Mastery: Deep expertise in Google/YouTube Ads and analytics platforms (We use Looker).
  • P&L Ownership: Experience managing budgets at scale and delivering on aggressive growth + margin goals.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to clearly and concisely articulate data and POV for easy understanding and leadership alignment.
  • Problem-Solving: Ability to turn performance data into actionable growth strategies.
  • Adaptability: Thrive in a fast-paced environment, quickly testing and iterating. Managing multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Leadership Potential: Desire and ability to grow into a manager role, building and leading a team.
  • Growth Focus: Commitment to staying ahead of video and performance marketing trends.
  • Operational Efficiency : Build campaigns in the best way to scale, which might not always be the best practice, that ensures we have all creative sizes, conversion events, or information to give you a competitive edge against competitor brands.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience with linear TV, streaming, or other video-first platforms (Meta, TikTok).
  • Experience with MMM tools and measurement solutions to understand the halo-effect of video efforts on other marketing channels.
  • Familiarity with AI tools (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, MidJourney, etc) for workflows.
  • Knowledge of personal finance and consumer financial products.
  • Experience mentoring peers or leading knowledge-sharing initiatives.
  • Familiarity with competitor analysis tools like SimilarWeb, AdBeat, Ahrefs, SpyFu, etc.

TOTAL COMPENSATION

Base salary is set according to market rates for the nearest major metro and varies based on Launch Potato’s Levels Framework. Launch Potato is a performance-driven company, which means once you are hired, future increases will be based on company and personal performance, not annual cost of living adjustments.

title: Senior Product Designer II, AI Breeze Assistant
description:
Overview

Building the Future of AI UX at HubSpot: A Culture of Collaboration, Curiosity, and Craft

At HubSpot, our AI team is not just researching customers—we're shaping how businesses and their customers interact with artificial intelligence in helpful, valuable, and intuitive ways. We're balancing innovation leveraging AI with a strong commitment to delivering real value to our customers.

What we're up to

Our AI team

Our AI team is growing rapidly—doubling in size this year. This growth is an opportunity to bring in teammates who will help us design in this exciting and highly ambiguous space. We seek fellow curious, bright, hardworking designers with a high bar for craft. We need dreamers who also move the mountains they see in the way. Because the field is moving at such great speeds, we don\'t see ourselves as experts, and are learning AI real-time. We\'ve approached building AI journeyman expertise as a team.

Researching for AI product experiences is exciting and also full of novel research challenges. Many users don\'t know what they want from AI; it\'s still a technology in search of a problem. Other users are skeptical, worried about or resistant to using AI. Mental models are still evolving and truly helpful quality is difficult to achieve. We\'ve embraced the ambiguity in this space by focusing on speedy exploration, scrappy insights, and learning from the quickly evolving marketplace.

We expect researchers to be opinionated and have an ownership mindset, approaching product and user questions with innate curiosity and a healthy dose of optimism.

What we\'re up to

Last year we launched CoPilot, an AI-powered conversational interface embedded across every page of HubSpot. The promise of CoPilot is a surface that allows any user at any moment to get AI assistance in context. The natural language interface allows the system to meet the users where they are at without needing to be overly technical.

We also invested in our first generation of AI agents. We learned a lot about the challenges and opportunities agents bring, which has allowed us to envision a more sophisticated evolution into an agent platform this year. This will empower both HubSpot and third-party creators to develop agents tailored to their unique use cases.

At INBOUND, we launched the next generation Breeze Assistant, a flagship AI experience built natively into HubSpot for marketers, sales reps, and service professionals. The new Breeze Assistant is available as a standalone mobile and desktop app as well as embedded directly in HubSpot, powered by our unified "AI Brain" that brings rich company and CRM context into every interaction. It\'s not just a chatbot or a help desk tool. Breeze Assistant proactively supports your workday preparing you for meetings with full CRM summaries, answering strategic business questions, synthesizing information from across your connected apps, and adapting a personalized experience for every customer.

At its heart, the work we\'re doing is about enabling HubSpot users to unlock their full professional potential. By reducing friction, managing complexity, and amplifying creativity, we\'re transforming how businesses use AI to achieve their goals. It\'s an exciting time to be at the intersection of AI and UX, and we\'re just getting started.

UX at HubSpot

What\'s not obvious from the outside (yet) is that Product Design at HubSpot is on a multi-year arc of transformation. From the top there\'s a deep commitment to building a research culture that feeds our organizational intuition about our customers. We\'re investing in craft across all areas of UX including research. You can see this with the caliber of the people we\'re hiring, setting exceptionally high standards, seeking the very best to help our entire organization understand at a core level the opportunities and the challenges in this quickly evolving industry.

Our UX team is a passionate and diverse group of more than 200 product designers, content designers, researchers, and design ops folks who build consumer-grade experiences while solving enterprise-level problems. We\'re set up to work as equal partners to our peers in product management and engineering. And we design and deliver a crafted experience to our customers by setting a high bar on ease of use. We\'re investing deeply in building whole and healthy UX teams across all of our disciplines so we can better solve problems for our customers.

We involve our customers in every step of our development process. And we strive to deliver a B2B product that\'s just as easy to use as the best B2C products on the market. When our customers grow, we grow, too!

As a designer, you are:

  • Autonomous & adaptable: You thrive in uncertainty and excel at solving unstructured problems.
  • A strategic systems thinker: You think holistically and can design for multiple personas and use cases.
  • Creative & future-focused: You bring innovative ideas and are eager to try new things, especially in AI.
  • A platform-minded problem-solver: You\'re excited to design tools and frameworks others will build upon.
  • Execution-strong: You bring clarity, influence across functions, and get things done with attention to detail.
  • Skilled in remote collaboration: You\'ve thrived in distributed team environments and can influence effectively from afar.
  • Curious with a growth-mindset: You\'re eager to learn new technologies and approaches, and can quickly adapt to evolving requirements and market trends

You align with HubSpot\'s HEART values (Humble, Empathetic, Adaptable, Remarkable, Transparent). Bonus points if you have experience with complex front-office systems like CRM or omnichannel tools.

Here\'s what success in your role looks like

We seek a Senior Product Designer II with end-to-end product design experience, ideally in sophisticated B2B SaaS or AI/ML products. As a Senior Product Designer II on our Customer Agent Growth, Onboarding, and Setup teams, you\'ll help set the vision and drive strategic outcomes across a significant portion of our product. You\'ll have a seat at the table from day one, working closely with product managers, engineers, and researchers.

You\'ll shape how customers discover, evaluate, and get value from our AI-powered product. This includes:

  • Product-led growth and first-time setup experiences
  • AI agent monetization and in-product discovery
  • Human AI handoffs and out-of-office support
  • Expanding omnichannel capabilities
  • Segmentation, targeting, and evolving to new front-office use cases

You will translate complex AI capabilities into intuitive and delightful user experiences that directly impact a key product area.

What you\'ll do:

  • Own and evolve the embedded conversational experience and its modalities across HubSpot.
  • Craft a simple, yet powerful experience for capturing user intent through conversational UX, integrating deep app connectors and making knowledge and workflows instantly accessible.
  • Invent new human-AI collaboration patterns for orchestrating work across HubSpot through Breeze Assistant.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to scale solutions and patterns across platforms and teams; codify new patterns you design in our design system.
  • Raise the bar for design quality and craft in AI-powered product areas.

You\'ll shape how customers seamlessly integrate Breeze Assistant into their workflow and learn new, faster ways to get work done by just asking Breeze to do the work for you.

Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Design & execution: Taking ownership of design initiatives from concept to launch, delivering high-quality user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups.
  • Problem solving: Breaking down complex, ambiguous AI problems into manageable, actionable design challenges, driving discovery and validation activities.
  • User-centered design: Conducting research (e.g., usability testing, interviews) to understand needs and pain points related to AI, synthesizing findings into actionable insights.
  • Collaboration: Working closely with cross-functional partners to influence design decisions and advocate for user needs.
  • Interaction & visual design: Designing interactions for AI-powered features, proposing multiple solutions, and applying visual design principles for polished, accessible interfaces.
  • Prototyping: Utilizing appropriate methods and tools to test hypotheses and communicate design intent efficiently.
  • Systems thinking: Considering the broader implications of your design decisions, ensuring consistency and scalability.
  • Mentorship: Actively participating in design critiques and contributing to the growth of junior designers.

One more thing you should know...

There\'s a lot of research showing how marginalized groups of people may not apply for jobs unless they meet 100% (or more!) of the qualifications. We also know that many UX folks come from backgrounds with different experiences that might not seem "standard"—and that\'s okay. We really value people who bring unique perspectives and add new knowledge to our team.

But you might not feel like you \"check all the boxes\" as you read this job post. We get it. And we feel these things ourselves, too. But we hope you\'ll apply anyway because we\'ll take great care in working with you.
Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we\'ll let you in on a secret: there\'s no such thing as a \"perfect\" candidate. HubSpot is a place where everyone can grow. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

Pay & Benefits

The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot\'s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot\'s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are tailored to your skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons.

This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see. Learn more about HubSpot\'s compensation philosophy.

Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better.

At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren\'t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It\'s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.

$161,500-$258,400 USD

We know the confidence gap and impostor syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don\'t hesitate to apply - we\'d love to hear from you.

If you need accommodations or assistance due to a disability, please reach out to us using this form.

Whether you\'re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you join our broader Product team, you\'ll also attend other in-person events such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings to continue building on those connections.

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot\'s connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We\'re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

description:

At RecargaPay, we’re on a mission to deliver the best payment experience for Brazilian consumers and small businesses — by building a powerful digital ecosystem where the banked and unbanked connect, and where consumers and merchants have a one-stop shop for all their financial needs.

If you’re ready to do your best work, at scale, with purpose — this is your place.

Responsibilities

As a Sr Software Engineer, you will play a critical role in the success of a constantly and fast-paced growing company. You will be designing, developing, and maintaining robust and scalable systems that support the company\'s financial services, ensuring seamless operations and an excellent user experience. In a competitive and fast-paced industry, this team drives innovation by implementing secure, reliable, and cutting-edge solutions to meet evolving customer needs.

  • Write well designed, testable, efficient code by using best software development practices.
  • Contribute in all phases of the development lifecycle.
  • Support continuous improvement by investigating alternatives and technologies and presenting these for architectural review.
  • Proposes initial technical implementation which supports architectural changes that solve scaling and performance problems.
  • Work with version control using GitHub, conflict resolution, and automation of continuous integration processes.
  • Create and maintain software documentation.
  • Experience in projects in the area of payments, open finance, among others, will be considered an important differential.
  • Academic background oriented toward computer science, engineering, or software development disciplines.
  • Experience hands-on engineering roles.
  • Experience to deal with medium domains with medium/high complexity.
  • A solid understanding of how web applications work including security, session management, and best development practices.
  • Knowledge of relational database systems and Object Oriented Programming.
  • Knowledge in Domain Driven Design. Knowing Microservice Architecture is a plus.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced environment, learn rapidly and master diverse web technologies and techniques.
  • Proven ability to design complex distributed applications built for high performance and throughput while being scalable and reliable.
  • Development using Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Kafka and AWS.
  • Experience with asynchronous programming.
  • Demonstrated experience profiling and performance tuning Java applications, and using monitoring tools for production application monitoring.
  • Practical experience applying AI frameworks in development project.

Soft Skills

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with cross-functional teams including Chapters Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure and Mobile Engineering.
  • Proactive mindset with a sense of ownership and accountability for delivering high-quality, user-centric mobile experiences.
  • Ability to mentor peers, share knowledge, and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence.
  • Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-changing environment, with openness to feedback and eagerness to learn.
  • Alignment with company values: ownership, excellence, adaptability, and innovation.

Industry-Specific Knowledge

It is desirable to have practical familiarity with one or more core financial domains such as lending, payments, credit cards, open finance, fraud prevention, merchant acquiring, or investment services, along with an understanding of their fundamental workflows and business drivers. Experience in how these domains intersect to influence revenue, risk management, and customer satisfaction is highly valued.

Ideally, candidates will have applied this knowledge to deliver solutions such as loan-origination engines with real-time decisioning; scalable payment-processing platforms integrated with core banking systems and third-party gateways; secure open-finance interfaces compliant with industry regulations; automated fraud-detection pipelines leveraging behavioral analytics; or financial reporting and reconciliation engines for regulatory compliance. The ability to translate complex compliance mandates (e.g., KYC/AML, PCI-DSS, GDPR) into resilient, high-performance systems without compromising user experience is considered a strong asset.

Process Stages

  1. 1. HR Interview

    Our first conversation will be a casual chat to get to know you, your background, and align expectations. We’ll conduct a brief technical evaluation and answer any questions you may have about the role, our culture, and what makes us unique. This is also an opportunity for you to learn more about us!

  2. 2. Assessment (Skills Mapping)

    We use an evaluation tool to understand your work style and how you align with our culture. This step helps us identify how your skills can enhance our solutions.

  3. 3. Technical Assessment

    Time to showcase your technical expertise! In this stage, you’ll work on technical challenges and have a discussion with our engineering team. We’ll explore your decisions, strategies, and how you design scalable and robust solutions. More than just an evaluation, this is a chance to exchange ideas and see how your solutions can impact RecargaPay!

  4. 4. Conversation with Leadership

    At this stage, you’ll meet the squad leader to discuss the challenges of the role, gain insights into the team’s daily work, and ensure alignment between our goals, culture, and your career expectations. What you'll do & how you'll make your mark.

1. Linux Systems Administration

Hands-on experience managing Linux servers, working with system services, troubleshooting performance issues, assisting with backups and recovery.

2. Networking Fundamentals

Good understanding of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls (iptables/nftables), and basic load balancing and troubleshooting in cloud and on-prem environments.

3. Web Server Management

Experience configuring and managing web servers like Apache or Nginx, including setting up virtual hosts and SSL certificates.

4. Public Cloud Infrastructure (AWS / GCP / OCI / Azure)

Exposure to core cloud services like compute, storage, networking, and IAM; familiar with cloud-based monitoring and backup tools.

5. Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

Practical experience using Terraform to provision and manage infrastructure; code versioned using Git and aligned with best practices.

6. Configuration Management

Working knowledge of tools like Ansible or Puppet to automate routine configuration and ensure consistency across environments.

7. CI/CD Pipeline Management

Experience building and maintaining CI/CD workflows using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI; exposure to automating builds, testing, and deployments.

8. Containerization & Orchestration

Hands-on experience using Docker for application packaging; exposure to Kubernetes for deploying and managing containerized workloads is desirable.

9. Monitoring & Observability

Familiarity with monitoring tools like Prometheus and Grafana; basic understanding of log aggregation systems such as ELK or Loki and setting up alerts.

10. Scripting & Automation

Comfortable writing Bash scripts and basic Python code to automate operational tasks and interact with APIs.

11. Incident Response & On-Call Readiness

Exposure to on-call support and troubleshooting production issues; involved in incident resolution and learning from post-incident reviews.

12. Security & System Hardening

Basic understanding of Linux security principles such as TLS, SSH hardening, patching, and IAM usage within cloud environments.

Who you are & what you'll need to succeed.

  • Work closely with developers and senior engineers to implement scalable, secure, and reliable infrastructure.

  • Manage cloud-based and on-premises environments, supporting compute, storage, and networking operations.

  • Troubleshoot Linux-based systems and assist in configuration, performance tuning, and system hardening.

  • Use cloud-native services and DevOps tools to automate infrastructure and streamline operations.

  • Write and maintain Python scripts and shell utilities to support automation and internal tools.

  • Assist in building CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and environment provisioning workflows.

  • Contribute to monitoring, logging, and alerting setup using modern observability tools.

  • Participate in on-call rotation and support incident investigation and resolution efforts.

  • Follow project plans and deliver assigned tasks within expected timelines and priorities.

description:
Our Mission

Our mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS.

Come be part of remarkable.

Overview

How you can make a difference

Are you passionate about identity and access management (IAM) and ready to make a meaningful impact? HealthEquity is seeking an IAM Application Onboarding Lead to help mature and scale our access administration practices. In this role, you’ll be a key contributor to our IAM Program—driving process improvements, identifying risks and opportunities, and ensuring secure, compliant access across our environment. You’ll collaborate with internal teams and stakeholders to onboard applications, enhance procedures, and promote a security-first mindset. Your work will help build a strong understanding of IAM’s value and benefits across the organization. We’re looking for someone who thrives in cross-functional environments, is proactive and detail-oriented, stays current with the latest security practices, communicates clearly and confidently and is excited to shape the future of IAM at HealthEquity. If you\'re ready to lead with purpose and help us safeguard access in a dynamic, growing organization—this is the role for you.

What you will do (Job Duties & Responsibilities)

  • Lead the intake and centralization of access administration for all internal HealthEquity applications, ensuring compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley and audit requirements.
  • Collaborate with application owners, technical teams, and Application Administrators to gather requirements, onboard applications to IAM, and recommend compliance controls.
  • Drive role-based access assessments, implement and automate RBAC processes, and help maintain IAM policies, standards, and guidelines.
  • Utilize SailPoint Identity Security Cloud and Excel for data analysis and access management; PowerShell scripting is a plus for integration and automation.
  • Work closely with engineering, operations, audit/compliance, and the User Access Certification & Governance team to ensure secure, compliant access and provide audit evidence when needed.
  • Act as a liaison among stakeholders to review, document, and communicate system activities, ensuring access assignments align with industry regulations, IAM principles, and a security-first mindset.
  • Integrate new applications with the IAM platform for provisioning and deprovisioning, and support execution of the IAM roadmap.
  • Provide IAM process guidance and requirements, create IAM solutions and roles for application onboarding, and develop process documentation for centralized access administration.
  • Facilitate collaboration and lead cross-functional teams and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) phases for defect fixes, enhancements, and critical initiatives.

What you will need to be successful (Skills, Knowledge, & Experience)

  • Solid understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) principles, processes, and tools such as SailPoint Identity Security Cloud, NERM, and OneTrust
  • Experience onboarding applications to IAM, conducting technical assessments, and implementing role-based access controls
  • Familiarity with Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance, audit requirements, and User Access Certification & Governance practices
  • Advanced Excel skills for data analysis and access management; PowerShell scripting for integration and data import tasks
  • Proficient in on-prem Active Directory and Entra ID
  • Strong ability to gather requirements, recommend controls, and collaborate with application owners and technical teams
  • Skilled in identifying issues, risks, and procedural irregularities; able to collect data, draw conclusions, and align resolution responsibilities
  • Effective communicator with the ability to influence others and navigate difficult conversations to uphold process and audit standards
  • Proven track record of implementing process improvements and educating stakeholders on changes
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience

HealthEquity has a vision that by 2030 we will make HSAs as wide-spread and popular as retirement accounts. At HealthEquity, our goal is to save and improve lives by empowering healthcare consumers. This shared purpose inspires everything we do, including how we approach hiring. The Financial Data Application Specialist role at AlphaSense lives at the intersection of sales, customer success, and technical implementation for AlphaSense's financial data products. This is a new team at AlphaSense supporting a strategic area of investment for the business, so we are looking for entrepreneurial minded people that can use learnings from client discussions to help optimize both our go-to-market and product strategies. This can come in the form of how-to videos, enablement, product marketing, support articles and others that can be used for meetings or email distribution.
  • Product Direction : Because of our Specialists' deep understanding of both our financial data products and customers, they are in a position to field feedback and identify product opportunities, and relay that information across the organization (account management, account executives, product, management).

  • Intrinsically motivated with the ability to contribute to a dynamic and entrepreneurial team culture.

  • Comfortable working in ambiguity, and flexible enough to adapt as needed to drive customer happiness.

description:
Overview

Implementation Specialist

Você busca desenvolver sua carreira e atuar como Implementation Specialist em uma empresa líder no segmento de Tecnologia? Junte-se a nós! A Thomson Reuters combina a inteligência, tecnologia e expertise humana para fornecer respostas confiáveis que ajudam os profissionais a tomar decisões confiantes e administrar melhor seus negócios. Nós ajudamos a reinventar a maneira como os profissionais trabalham, reunindo informação, inovação e insight para desvendar situações complexas nos mercados Tributário, Comércio Exterior, Contábil e Jurídico, respaldando nossos clientes na tomada de decisão.

About the Role / Sobre a Posição

Nesta oportunidade como Implementation Specialist, você irá:

  • Atuar como parte do time de implementação, conduzindo análises de negócio e entendimento do contexto do cliente.

  • Participar de sessões de levantamento de requisitos e transformar essas informações em documentação de solução.

  • Traduzir as necessidades e políticas do cliente em configurações funcionais dentro do software.

  • Personalizar e configurar a aplicação de acordo com as especificações acordadas.

  • Sugerir formas de trabalho mais eficientes e ágeis, com base nas melhores práticas.

  • Preparar e executar scripts e casos de teste para validação da solução.

  • Fornecer treinamentos a usuários finais e equipes de desenvolvimento do cliente.

  • Oferecer suporte contínuo para problemas escalados após a entrega.

  • Trabalhar em colaboração com times internos como Produto e Engenharia, quando necessário.

  • Elaborar e documentar entregáveis conforme cronograma e orçamento definidos.

  • Apoiar novos membros da equipe e contribuir com a evolução dos processos internos.

  • Atuar com autonomia na execução das tarefas, com contato eventual com o(a) Project Manager.

About You / Sobre você

Para esta posição, buscamos profissionais com as Habilidades & Experiência:

  • Experiência comprovada em implantação técnica, com atuação direta com clientes.

  • Vivência em ambientes B2B, preferencialmente com interação com advogados ou áreas jurídicas.

  • Perfil consultivo, com forte capacidade de análise e resolução de problemas.

  • Formação superior em Tecnologia, Direito ou áreas correlatas.

  • Habilidade para entender processos de negócio e propor soluções personalizadas.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia no setor de tecnologia ou jurídico;

  • Certificação em gestão de projetos (como PMP, CAPM, PRINCE2 ou similares);

  • Inglês avançado.

#LI-RB1

O que iremos te oferecer?

  • Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido: Adotamos um ambiente de trabalho híbrido e flexível (2-3 dias por semana no escritório, dependendo do papel) para funções baseadas em escritório, garantindo uma experiência integrada e coerente tanto no âmbito digital quanto presencial.

  • Flexibilidade e Equilíbrio entre Trabalho e Vida Pessoal: "Flex My Way" consiste em um conjunto de políticas de projetadas para facilitar a gestão das responsabilidades pessoais e profissionais, seja cuidando da família, participando de atividades comunitárias ou dedicando tempo para descanso e renovação pessoal. Essas políticas se baseiam em nossa abordagem flexível de trabalho, permitindo que os funcionários trabalhem de qualquer lugar por até 8 semanas por ano, promovendo assim um equilíbrio ideal entre seus compromissos de trabalho e pessoais.

  • Desenvolvimento e Crescimento Profissional: Promovemos uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo e desenvolvimento de habilidades, preparando nossos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do futuro e oferecer soluções reais. Nosso programa "Grow My Way" e a abordagem focada em habilidades garantem que você tenha as ferramentas e conhecimentos para crescer, liderar e prosperar em um futuro habilitado pela inteligência artificial.

  • Benefícios Competitivos do Setor: Oferecemos planos de benefícios abrangentes que incluem assistência médica e odontológica, dois dias de feriado corporativo para saúde mental, programas de incentivo por performance e recursos para o bem-estar mental, físico e financeiro.

  • Cultura: Reconhecida globalmente por inclusão e pertencimento, flexibilidade, equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Vivemos nossos valores: obsessão pelos nossos clientes, competir para ganhar, desafiar o (seu) nosso pensamento, agir rápido e aprender rápido e juntos somos mais fortes.

  • Impacto Social: Gere um impacto em sua comunidade com nosso Instituto de Impacto Social. Oferecemos a todos colaboradores dois dias de voluntariado pagos anualmente e oportunidades para se envolver em projetos de consultoria pro bono e iniciativas de Meio Ambiente, Sociais e de Governança (ESG).

  • Fazendo um Impacto Real no Mundo: Somos uma das poucas empresas globalmente que auxilia seus clientes na busca por justiça, verdade e transparência. Trabalhando em conjunto com os profissionais e instituições que servimos, contribuímos para sustentar o estado de direito, fomentar o comércio, detectar infratores, relatar os fatos e oferecer informações confiáveis e imparciais para pessoas em todo o mundo.

Quem somos

A Thomson Reuters informa o caminho adiante ao reunir conteúdo confiável e a tecnologia que pessoas e organizações precisam para tomar decisões corretas. Servimos profissionais nos setores jurídico, fiscal, contábil, de conformidade, governamental e de mídia. Nossos produtos combinam software altamente especializado e informações para capacitar profissionais com os dados, inteligência e soluções necessárias para tomar decisões informadas e ajudar as instituições em sua busca por justiça, verdade e transparência. A agência de notícias Reuters, parte da Thomson Reuters, é líder mundial na área de jornalismo e notícias confiáveis.

Contamos com o talento de 26.000 colaboradores em mais de 70 países, onde todos têm a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer profissionalmente em ambientes de trabalho flexíveis. Em um momento em que objetividade, precisão, equidade e transparência estão sob ataque, estamos comprometidos em buscá-los. Ficou interessado? Faça parte da nossa equipe e contribua para moldar as indústrias que impulsionam o progresso da sociedade.

Como uma empresa global, confiamos no conhecimento único, perspectivas e experiências de todos os colaboradores para cumprir nossos objetivos comerciais. Para garantir que possamos fazer isso, buscamos colaboradores talentosos e qualificados em todas as nossas operações ao redor do mundo, independentemente de raça, cor, sexo/gênero, incluindo gestantes, identidade e expressão de gênero, origem nacional, religião, orientação afetivo-sexual, deficiência, idade, estado civil, status de cidadania, ou outra classificação protegida pela lei aplicável.

Além disso, oferecemos acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiências e para aquelas com crenças religiosas sinceras, conforme a legislação vigente. Você pode encontrar mais informações sobre como solicitar uma adaptação.

Descubra como se proteger de anúncios de emprego fraudulentos. Para obter mais informações sobre a Thomson Reuters, visite nosso site em thomsonreuters.com.

description:
Overview

Quem somos

A Smarthis é uma empresa de tecnologia que desenvolve soluções feitas de humanos para humanos! Acreditamos que boas soluções surgem de fortes conexões entre pessoas, conhecimentos, ideias e ideais. Por isso, ser Smarther é mais do que fazer parte de uma empresa, é viver verdadeiramente a cultura da colaboração e inovação que pulsa em nosso DNA.

Com um time formado por diferentes gêneros, cores, crenças, culturas e orientações afetivas, que estão espalhados por todo o Brasil (e mundo!), nosso objetivo é auxiliar nossos clientes em seus desafios para a transformação digital. Desenvolvendo produtos e serviços tecnológicos para seus negócios, combinando o melhor do RPA (Robotic Process Automation), Data Analytics e Inteligência Artificial, por um time que tem paixão por inovação, desafios e aprendizado.

Nossos Diferenciais:

Somos Great Place to Work – O respeito e o cuidado com o nosso time foram fundamentais para conquistarmos a premiação: desde 2021, somos reconhecidos anualmente como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil. Isso é resultado da união de um time com uma cultura alinhada com a nossa visão de crescimento para o futuro.

100 Startups to Watch – Estamos na lista das startups mais promissoras e inovadoras do ecossistema do Brasil, segundo a Pequenas Empresas e Grandes Negócios. O desenvolvimento das equipes e a maturidade para encontrar soluções nos trouxeram essa premiação importante.

UiPath Professional Services & Diamond Partner – Somos a primeira empresa da América Latina a alcançar as principais certificações da empresa líder mundial em RPA.

One Hundred Startups – Somos reconhecidos como uma das 100 startups mais relevantes em ecossistemas corporativos de inovação, pela 100 Open Startups, a plataforma pioneira e líder de Open Innovation.

Scale-Up Endeavor – Acelerados pela Endeavor, a comunidade global líder de empreendedores de alto impacto, fazemos parte do programa de aceleração das empresas que mais crescem no Brasil, levando a transformação digital para o mercado

Onde Estamos:

Atualmente, temos escritórios no Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Miami, Buenos Aires, Madrid e Perth. Mas não se preocupe! Para os que estiverem trabalhando remotamente, nossa cultura permanece a mesma: Integração total com happy hour online, noite de jogos, lives e outras programações legais!

Main responsibilities

Seu trabalho será

  • Junto com sua equipe de projetos, você irá contribuir para uma entrega de soluções, ajudando aos nossos clientes na sua transformação digital;
  • Você vai poder usar toda sua paixão e vontade de programar no seu dia a dia.

Requirements and skills

O que você precisa ter

  • Graduação concluída;
  • Experiencia com MuleSoft;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento e integração de APIs;
  • Conhecimento em alguma linguagem de programação (NET, Python, PHP, Java, C#, VBA, VB Script, entre outras);
  • inglês avançado ou fluente (precisará utilizar no dia a dia).

Excelente se tiver

  • Conhecimento em Machine Learning, Business Intelligence ou RPA (Robotic Process Automation);

Additional information

O processo seletivo

A transparência é um de nossos princípios e por isso fazemos questão de compartilhar cada etapa da seleção. Dessa forma você já sabe o que esperar!

  1. Primeiro encontro: Alinhamento cultural
  2. Teste de habilidades: Análise técnica
  3. Segundo encontro: Conversa com o gestor

Ah, e não se preocupe! Prezamos pela cultura do feedback e sabemos como uma resposta, seja ela positiva ou negativa, é fundamental. Portanto, ao final de cada etapa, você será informado se foi ou não aprovado no processo.

Nossos Valores e Incentivos

Aqui entendemos que o nosso principal ativo é você. Por isso, fazemos questão de proporcionar um ambiente seguro e confortável onde nossa equipe cresça e se desenvolva tanto pessoal quanto profissionalmente. Pensando nisso, aqui estão alguns incentivos que oferecemos:

  • Participação dos lucros e resultados
  • Plano de Saúde e Plano Odontológico
  • Totalpass
  • Cartão de benefícios flexíveis
  • Zenklub
  • Programa de Idiomas
  • Parceria com FIAP Escola de Tecnologia
  • Trabalho Remoto
  • Programa de treinamento
  • Plano de carreira definido
  • Horário flexível
  • Programa de mentoria
  • Licença parental estendida
  • Auxílio Creche

Além disso, temos também iniciativas internas de Live coding, Happy hours, esportes ao ar livre, Coding Dojo (treinamento gamificado), rodas de conversa, entre outros. Ou seja, atividades para todos os gostos!

E aí, deu match?! Então vem acelerar a revolução digital com a gente!

VAGA ENGENHEIRO DE MACHINE LEARNING (SÊNIOR) | Grupo EasyLocal: 100% Home Office. Modalidade de Contratação: PJ ou Cooperado. Tempo de Projeto: Indeterminado.

Responsabilidades

  • Anotar e preparar datasets de visão computacional.
  • Projetar, treinar, validar e otimizar modelos de deep learning para classificação, detecção e segmentação de imagens.
  • Treinar e implementar modelos YOLO (You Only Look Once) para tarefas de detecção de objetos.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de inferência para execução eficiente em produção.
  • Implementar práticas de MLOps: CI/CD de modelos, versionamento de dados e de experimentos, monitoramento e retreinamento automático.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com engenheiros de software para integrar os modelos em sistemas e aplicações.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Conhecimento de Python em quaisquer das bibliotecas de ML/DL (PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV).
  • Experiência prática com YOLO (treinamento e inferência em problemas de detecção de objetos).
  • Experiência sólida em visão computacional (classificação, detecção, segmentação).
  • Experiência em MLOps com quaisquer das ferramentas: AWS SageMaker Studio, MLflow, Kubeflow, Docker, Kubernetes, Airflow.
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de engenharia de software (Git, testes automatizados, ambientes reprodutíveis).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em dados estruturados: preparação de dataset, treinamento e inferência em problemas de regressão e classificação tabular.
  • Análise exploratória de dados estruturados (PCA, correlações, clustering com K-Means).
  • Otimização de modelos para edge devices (TensorRT, ONNX, quantização).
  • Contribuições para projetos open source ou publicações técnicas.

Métricas e gráficos que devem ser interpretados

  • Visão computacional (foco principal): curvas Precision-Recall, AP por classe, curva ROC/AUC, matriz de confusão, curvas de perda e acurácia durante o treinamento, distribuição de IoU.
  • Learning curves (treino vs. validação).
  • Dados estruturados (diferencial): gráficos de resíduos em regressão, curvas de calibração, feature importance, SHAP, PDP/ICE, heatmaps de correlação e PCA.
  • MLOps / produção: gráficos de drift de dados, distribuição de probabilidades de saída (overconfidence).
  • Métricas de latência/throughput, consumo de GPU/CPU/memória em inferência.

Why are you being asked to complete this form?

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)

description:
Company Summary

Company Summary: Slang.ai is redefining customer engagement through conversational AI, making every interaction seamless and efficient. Our mission is to transform the restaurant industry by providing the ultimate voice AI solution for consistently outstanding customer experiences. At Slang.ai, we foster a culture of innovation, inclusivity, and growth, ensuring that every "Slangsta" (employee) feels valued and connected to our broader AI driven impact.

What Your Experience Will Be

You\'ll join Slang\'s Engineering team as a Full Stack Software Engineer (contractor), working as part of a new Integrations pod focused on building seamless connections with third-party reservation systems. Your work will enable restaurants to connect their existing reservation platforms with Slang\'s conversational AI solutions, creating a unified experience for booking reservations and events. You\'ll spend roughly 70% of your time developing robust backend services in Kotlin to handle these integrations, with the remaining 30% contributing to React/TypeScript frontend features for configuration and monitoring. Your work will directly impact thousands of restaurant interactions daily, helping businesses automate bookings and improve customer service through natural conversation while leveraging their existing technology investments.

You\'ll report to the Engineering Manager, collaborating closely with product managers, conversation designers, and fellow engineers. The role requires 4+ hours of daily overlap with EST (12:30-4:30 PM ET), with attendance at key ceremonies including daily standups at 1:00 PM ET, bi-weekly cycle planning, and weekly Show & Tell sessions. As a remote contractor, you\'ll use modern collaboration tools like Slack, GitHub, and video conferencing to stay connected with the team. Once ramped up, you\'ll have opportunities to mentor junior and other mid-level engineers through code reviews and pair programming sessions.

Why You Belong Here & How You Will Grow

Our engineering culture emphasizes pragmatic solutions, continuous learning, and collaborative problem-solving. We believe in domain-driven design, comprehensive testing, and building systems that gracefully handle the complexities of real-world restaurant operations. You\'ll work alongside engineers who are passionate about creating reliable, scalable conversational experiences and who regularly share knowledge through Show & Tell sessions and detailed technical documentation. As a contractor, you\'ll gain exposure to cutting-edge conversational AI technologies, telephony systems at scale, and modern cloud-native architectures. You\'ll deepen your expertise in Kotlin and functional programming while working with production systems handling real-time voice interactions. The cross-functional nature of the role—spanning backend, frontend, and AI integrations—will accelerate your growth toward senior engineering roles. You\'ll learn from experienced engineers while contributing your own perspectives to architectural decisions and technical standards.

What Success Looks Like

  • Design and implement scalable Kotlin backend services following domain-driven design principles, with comprehensive error handling and testing
  • Develop and maintain GraphQL APIs that efficiently serve both internal and external clients
  • Build React/TypeScript frontend components that provide intuitive interfaces for restaurant staff and customers
  • Create robust integrations with Twilio telephony services and Dialogflow conversational AI, handling edge cases and failure scenarios gracefully
  • Design efficient Firestore data models that balance performance, cost, and maintainability
  • Implement comprehensive observability including logging, metrics, tracing, and actionable alerting
  • Deliver production-ready code with appropriate test coverage (unit, integration, and end-to-end tests)
  • Participate actively in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and incorporating suggestions
  • Document technical decisions, API contracts, and system architecture clearly
  • Deploy containerized applications to Google Cloud Platform following cloud-native best practices
  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to refine requirements and deliver features that meet business needs
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and help establish coding standards and best practices

What you will Bring

  • 3-5 years of professional software development experience with full stack applications
  • Strong proficiency in at least one JVM language (Kotlin, Java, or Scala) with understanding of functional programming concepts
  • Experience building and consuming RESTful or GraphQL APIs
  • Hands-on experience with React and TypeScript for frontend development
  • Familiarity with NoSQL databases and data modeling concepts
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Strong understanding of software testing practices and test-driven development
  • Excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills across the full stack
  • Ability to work independently and manage time effectively in a remote environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration
  • Available for 40 hours per week with 4+ hours daily overlap with EST
  • Preferred Qualifications:
    • Experience with Kotlin specifically and its idioms
    • Familiarity with GraphQL schema design and implementation
    • Experience with Google Cloud Platform services (Firestore, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub)
    • Knowledge of telephony systems (Twilio or similar) and webhook integrations
    • Experience with conversational AI platforms (Dialogflow, Lex, or similar)
    • Infrastructure as code experience with Terraform
    • Understanding of event-driven architectures and distributed systems patterns
    • Experience with observability tools and practices (structured logging, distributed tracing)
    • Previous experience in a contractor or consultant role
    • Interest in restaurant/hospitality technology domain

Core Responsibilities & Technical Standards

  • Design and implement backend services using Kotlin and the JVM ecosystem (primary focus)
  • Develop GraphQL queries and mutations for client-server communication
  • Contribute to React frontend components and features as needed
  • Create modular, testable code following domain-driven design principles
  • Implement proper error handling, logging, and graceful degradation patterns
  • Write comprehensive unit and integration tests across the stack
  • Data Modeling and Storage
  • Design and implement Firestore data models that optimize for performance and maintainability
  • Create efficient data access patterns and queries

We’re looking for a remote Senior QA Lead to transform our quality assurance processes and guide our QA team through a critical scaling phase. Because of the use of advanced AI coding tools, our development velocity has outpaced our testing capacity, and you’ll play a key role in bringing balance by introducing smarter testing strategies and automation.

Your first 2–3 months will focus on eliminating current bottlenecks by accelerating regression automation and optimizing QA allocation across product pods. Beyond that, you’ll shape the long-term QA strategy, ensuring quality and velocity scale together as the organization grows.

Ideal Candidate

6+ years of QA experience with at least 2 years in leadership roles, combining deep automation expertise with proven team management capabilities. You should be comfortable writing Selenium scripts and running chapter meetings, with extensive cross-platform testing experience across web, mobile, and IoT environments. You thrive in fast-paced scaling environments and can implement AI-driven testing strategies, streamline processes, and elevate team capabilities while maintaining high quality standards.

Your performance will be measured by automating 100% of the regression suite within 2-3 months, reducing testing cycles, and decreasing customer-reported bugs through improved product quality.

  • Requirements Analysis & Sprint Participation: Review acceptance criteria with Product Managers and identify missing edge cases, happy paths, and negative scenarios; participate in weekly product lead calls to define requirements; contribute to sprint planning and biweekly sprint cycles.

  • Team Leadership & Development: Run monthly QA chapter meetings to set goals and establish SOPs; create quarterly learning objectives for team skill development; conduct 1:1s with manual QA Engineers.
  • Performance & API Testing (Long-term): Implement performance testing using JMeter; develop API testing strategies with Postman; establish load testing and monitoring capabilities.

title: Engineering Manager - Charlotte AI (Remote, East Coast)
description:
Overview

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We’re also a mission-driven company. We cultivate a culture that gives every CrowdStriker both the flexibility and autonomy to own their careers. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About The Role

As an Engineering Manager for Charlotte AI at CrowdStrike, you\'ll be responsible for building and supporting the teams that develop and maintain our revolutionary generative AI-powered virtual security analyst. You will focus on the wellbeing and professional growth of everyone in our group, and you\'ll drive the hiring that will enable us to scale at an accelerated pace. You\'ll help foster an open and collaborative environment and ensure that your group is set up to succeed and to keep roadmap delivery on track.

With a focus on Charlotte AI product engineering, you will work with a talented and dedicated group of cloud, SDET, and frontend engineers, as well as AI/ML Data Scientists to provide the high-quality, high-scale AI-powered security systems that customers around the world use 24/7 to defend against the most sophisticated adversaries. You\'ll also collaborate closely with product managers to optimize our roadmap and with the design team to maintain a consistent user experience across all our products. Our ideal candidates are passionate about building autonomous teams, growing people, AI/ML systems, cloud-native architectures, user experience, and loves to find solutions in the cutting-edge intersection of AI and cybersecurity.

We operate with a startup mindset inside a global cybersecurity leader. The Charlotte AI team functions as a complete product unit, working closely with dedicated product managers, UX designers, and security strategists to iterate quickly on customer needs. We embrace a fast-paced working process with rapid experimentation and release cycles, which means engineers own their work end-to-end – from initial design to deploying features that immediately impact users. We provide opportunities to learn new skills, mentor fellow engineers, and contribute to the direction of both the team and the products for which we\'re responsible. We work in a distributed, remote-first, high-trust environment.

Our Products

You will join the Charlotte AI Product Group. Charlotte AI is a generative AI-powered virtual security analyst that helps any user – from novice to expert – operate like a seasoned SOC analyst. Our product helps organizations:

  • Accelerate threat detection and response - Converting hours of work into minutes or seconds by handling tedious data gathering and analysis via simple queries
  • Automate detection triage - Charlotte autonomously analyzes and prioritizes alerts with over 98% accuracy, filtering out false positives and low-risk events
  • Bridge the cybersecurity skills gap - By allowing analysts to ask plain-language questions of their security data and automating complex reasoning
  • Enable faster decision-making - Charlotte surfaces hidden threats and answers pressing security questions in seconds, so teams can respond faster and with greater confidence

Learn more about Charlotte AI here:

Charlotte AI started as an ambitious idea incubated by a small team in our Romanian engineering center about two years ago. The first version launched in early 2024, and it quickly proved transformative. What began as a local innovation is now one of CrowdStrike\'s flagship products, available to Falcon platform customers across multiple regions. Charlotte AI has garnered industry recognition – for instance, its new agentic response/workflow features were named among the hottest cybersecurity products of 2025.

What You\'ll Do

  • Lead and build one or more teams of engineers building Charlotte AI software offerings, with a focus on AI/ML engineering, backend systems, and UI/UX engineering.
  • Manage organizational structure and workload, project resourcing & coordination in a fast-paced, highly distributed environment with rapid iteration cycles.
  • Support wellbeing of team members - providing support & guidance focused primarily on resourcing, progress, and soft skills. Gather feedback from others, provide coaching as needed & in collaboration with senior engineers and managers to advance team member skill sets in AI/ML and distributed systems.
  • Drive the recruitment process from initial contact to on-boarding, with emphasis on finding engineers passionate about AI and cybersecurity.
  • Contribute to the product roadmap, set up your group to deliver it over the next 12-18 months, and share that information back to other managers and team members.
  • Participate in team activities, such as quarterly roadmap planning, to prioritize AI/ML projects on the roadmap based on availability of humans to do the work and business objectives that need to be met.
  • Collaborate closely with AI/ML researchers, data scientists, and security experts to push the boundaries of AI in cyber defense.
  • Have fun solving difficult problems at the intersection of artificial intelligence and cybersecurity.

What You\'ll Need

  • Strong engineering track-record and deep technical knowledge, preferably with experience in AI/ML, distributed systems, or cloud-native architectures.
  • Experience mentoring & supporting people and teams with empathy & professionalism, particularly in fast-paced, innovation-driven environments.
  • Experience leading through others and setting up multiple teams for success in rapid iteration cycles.
  • Experience working with Product Managers and UX Designers for requirement analysis and driving the engineering team to come up with solution approach and design for delivering AI-powered requirements.
  • Track record of shaping product roadmaps in the short and medium term, particularly for customer-facing products.
  • Experience planning, tracking, delivering and managing multiple projects in startup-like environments.
  • Understanding of modern software development practices including microservices, cloud platforms, and agile methodologies.

Bonus Points

  • Experience and knowledge in the areas of AI/ML engineering, Large Language Models (LLMs), and generative AI technologies.
  • Knowledge of and experience with technical teams, cybersecurity, and AI/ML startups strongly preferred.
  • Experience with cloud-native technologies (Go, Python, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS).
  • Experience in remote-first environments and global teams.
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, vector databases, and AI model training and deployment.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity domain knowledge and security operations.

  • Academic background oriented toward computer science, engineering, or software development disciplines.

  • Working knowledge of Python and asynchronous programming.
  • Knowledge of relational database systems and Object Oriented Programming.
  • Solid understanding of web and mobile application architecture, including security, session management and development best practices.
  • Expertise in Domain-Driven Design and microservices architecture.
  • Ability to design high-performance, scalable and reliable distributed systems.
  • Experience defining and executing architectural roadmaps.
  • Practical experience with AWS and cloud-native development.
  • Solid knowledge of DevSecOps and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions).

  • Demonstrated experience profiling and tuning Java applications.

Soft Skills

Industry-Specific Knowledge

You bring practical familiarity with one or more core financial domains, such as lending, payments, credit cards, open finance, fraud prevention, merchant acquiring or investment services, and understand their fundamental workflows and business drivers. You appreciate how these areas intersect and influence revenue, risk management and customer satisfaction.

In practice, you have leveraged this expertise to architect and deliver solutions such as loan-origination engines with real-time decisioning; scalable payment-processing platforms integrated with core banking and third-party gateways; secure open-finance interfaces compliant with industry regulations; automated fraud-detection pipelines using behavioral analytics; financial reporting and reconciliation engines that generate regulatory reports. You translate complex compliance mandates (KYC/AML, PCI-DSS, GDPR) into resilient, high-performance systems without sacrificing user experience.

Process Stages

  1. HR Interview : Our first contact will be a casual conversation to learn about you, your career journey, and align expectations. We’ll conduct a brief technical assessment and answer your questions about the role, our culture, and what makes us unique. We want you to get to know us better too!
  2. Assessment (skills mapping) : We use an evaluation tool to map your work style and how you align with our culture. This step helps us understand how your skills can enhance our solutions.
  3. Technical Assessment : Now it’s time to showcase your technical talent! In this step, you’ll solve technical cases and have a discussion with our engineering team. We’ll dive into your decisions, strategies, and how you design scalable and robust solutions. Beyond evaluation, we want to exchange ideas and explore how your solutions can impact RecargaPay!
  4. Conversation with Leadership : Here, you’ll meet the squad leader to understand the position’s challenges, discuss the team’s daily activities, and evaluate alignment between our goals, culture, and your career aspirations. This will be an open space to align expectations and ensure RecargaPay is a place where you can grow and make a difference.
  5. Offer : If we’ve made it this far together, we’d be thrilled to invite you to join our team! You’ll receive a detailed proposal with all the information about the role, benefits, and the impact you’ll have with us. We can’t wait to welcome you!

Benefits

  • Competitive and market-aligned salary.
  • Remote work — wherever you are, you’re part of the team!
  • Home office allowance through a monthly deposit in the RecargaPay app.
  • Health and dental plans with no co-pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Flexible meal allowance (via Flash).
  • TotalPass membership to take care of your health.
  • Spanish or Portuguese classes.

Diversity & Inclusion

At RecargaPay, you’ll have the freedom to be who you are because we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us more creative and stronger. Here, everyone is welcome to express themselves authentically. We value the richness of each journey and the multiple ways of seeing the world, without distinctions of gender, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic that makes us unique.

By sharing your resume with us, you authorize the use of your data for analysis during the selection process and possibly for other opportunities within the RecargaPay group. You can request the update or deletion of your information at any time, in accordance with LGPD (General Data Protection Law).

Overview

ClickHouse the hottest analytic database on the planet and Altinity is the home of ClickHouse experts who build real-time data solutions that run anywhere. You’ll work directly on CI/CD infrastructure that powers our Altinity Stable Builds—a curated release stream of ClickHouse optimized for production use—and contribute to both Altinity’s ClickHouse fork and the official ClickHouse upstream repository.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Own the CI/CD process for Altinity Stable Builds, delivering reliable, production-grade ClickHouse releases
  • Work on CI/CD and automation code in Altinity’s ClickHouse fork and upstream ClickHouse
  • Maintain and improve GitHub self-hosted runners and supporting infrastructure
  • Build, sign, and publish .deb, .rpm, and Docker images to internal and public registries
  • Collaborate with ClickHouse development and QA teams to ship high-quality builds and features
  • Investigate and resolve CI/CD failures, flaky tests, and build regressions
  • Design automation to make release workflows more reliable, repeatable, and self-healing
  • Proactively monitor infrastructure and pipelines to ensure 24/7 availability

Desired Skills & Experiences:

  • Excellent knowledge of cloud infrastructure management: AWS is required; familiarity with GCP and Azure is a plus.
  • Excellent Python programming, Shell/Bash scripting, and Linux system administration skills
  • Deep familiarity with git and modern build systems like CMake and Ninja
  • Strong experience building and debugging CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions
  • Hands-on expertise in creating and publishing .deb, .rpm, and Docker images
  • Solid understanding of containers and virtualization technologies
  • Ability to methodically debug complex infrastructure problems and eliminate root causes
  • Strong documentation and communication habits
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working in open-source and globally distributed environments

Having one or more of the following is a big plus:

  • Experience with ClickHouse
  • Experience with C++
  • Experience with open-source projects

Our Benefits:

  • Work from Anywhere, Anytime: We are not your typical nine-to-five shop! Enjoy the flexibility of working from literally wherever and whenever. Create a schedule that works for you and your family or lifestyle. Recharge your batteries with our open vacation policies.
  • Cultural Diversity: We love that we get to work with passionate people from around the world. Currently, our team is made of professionals from 20 different countries!
  • Career Development and Learning Culture: We provide opportunities to learn new technologies as well as try out new roles; opportunities to learn ClickHouse deeply, contribute to open source, and grow into senior or platform roles. We also offer access to training on leading-edge technologies, plus flexible work schedules for external education.
  • Technical Depth: Be part of a team that’s building the infrastructure for real-time analytics at a global scale. Grow your skills in Kubernetes, distributed databases, observability, and automation.
  • USA Employees Benefits: We offer comprehensive PPO health care plans for our US-based employees that are incredibly flexible to meet the needs of individuals or families. 401K with company match also available.
  • Company Travel: We come together in person two to three times per year in locations across the globe. During non-pandemic times, of course! We also fund travel to conferences and encourage presentations as well as contributions to open source communities.

Apply now and tell us how your Operator, DevOps, or SRE background can help scale the future of cloud-native analytics.

This is a full-time position and includes equity in the company. Altinity is venture-funded and financially stable. We are 100% remote. You may work anywhere you have work permits.

title: Director Product Manager, Regional Virtual Card Lead – SME
description:
Overview

Director Product Manager, Regional Virtual Card Lead – SME

Mastercard is a technology company in the global payments space. We connect consumers, financial institutions, merchants, governments, and businesses worldwide, enabling them to use electronic forms of payment instead of cash and checks. We use technology and data-driven insights to make electronic payments more convenient, secure, and efficient for people everywhere. Our business has a global reach—extending to more than 210 countries and territories—and continues to experience growth in a world where 85% of retail transactions are still made in cash and checks.

Micro, Small, and Medium Businesses (SMEs) are a critical driver of global economic growth and represent 75% of the global workforce and about 50% of the global GDP. SMEs foster inclusion, with minorities owning 45% of small businesses and 1/3 of small businesses being women-owned. SMEs have become a top priority for many governments and enterprises.

Mastercard segment strategy is based on continuing to drive growth in core products and developing new innovative solutions while expanding product distribution.

The successful candidate will be the key regional virtual card number (VCN) resource that will partner with Mastercard stakeholders within the region, along with banks, acquirers, fintechs and other SME service providers. They will identify, support and, at times, lead all go-to-market opportunities for virtual card spend and distribution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a regional strategy for VCN and in SME.
  • Define possible partnership framework, assess global partners, and accelerate efforts to drive incremental B2B volumes across the regions.
  • Provide trends, insights, and changes to the SME landscape to support our segment strategy in both physical and virtual card spend.
  • Collaborate with global SME segment product management and development teams on ensuring SME products and solutions are developed and enhanced with SME and non-bank distribution partners’ inputs in mind and according to the SME product distribution standards.
  • Provide support regional product and sales teams in customer and partner facing conversations (in pre and after-sales) on card controls, virtual cards, and tokenization. This includes having a detailed understanding of product features to identify and implement solutions (in partnership with the Customer Solutions Centre and the local product team).
  • Provide support to the sales teams in pre and after-sales partner meetings.
  • Partner with global government, fintech, digital partnerships and GPS teams to identify potential SME B2B use cases, risks, and regulations.
  • Develop use cases, playbooks, and distribution model archetypes that can be leveraged for scaling efforts.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to capture more SME B2B flows. GTM/Rollout support for all new B2B solutions, partnerships and initiatives.

All About You

  • Able to navigate conversations that are both technical and business oriented.
  • Excellent writing skills and experience creating training materials, product guides, etc.
  • Experienced working with Engineering; familiar and comfortable with technical specifications (API, Batch).
  • Experienced and knowledgeable in the card payment ecosystem and flows – both data and money.
  • Understanding of competitive offerings and industry trends; international market knowledge/experience.
  • Strong B2B and embedded payments experience and understanding of SME B2B flows, such as delegated spend, accounts payable, embedded finance, trade use cases.
  • Able to work independently and with minimal guidance.
  • Self-motivated and thrives in a fast-paced environment; ready to take on stretch goals.
  • Flexible and creative, able to adapt and thrive in a constantly changing environment with the ability to multitask and adjust to evolving responsibilities.
  • Ability to storyboard and develop visually compelling presentations with clear logic and structure.
  • Ability to lead initiatives from start to finish, with excellent time management and organizational skills.
  • Builds cross-functional organizational relationships and establishes an internal network to execute against strategy successfully.
  • Strong customer relationship-building and management skills that result in meeting and managing the demands of internal and external customers.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks come with inherent risk. Every person working for or on behalf of Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach;
  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
