title: Lead Producer
description:
Jam City are looking for a motivated and skilled Lead Producer to join our team. You’ll work with designers, artists, engineers, product managers, QA analysts, and other producers to develop new game content like features, events, sales, and visuals.

About the role: A Lead Producer is a senior management role responsible for overseeing the production of a specific product or major aspect of a product or several smaller products. They are accountable for the overall success of the project, managing budgets, timelines, and resources across multiple teams. Lead Producers drive strategic decisions, foster a collaborative and efficient development environment (potentially leveraging agile frameworks), and ensure clear communication between all stakeholders, including executive leadership. They typically manage a team of Producers and other production staff, providing mentorship and guidance. This role reports to an Executive Producer, Product Director or GM.

Responsibilities

  • Accountable for the overall success of a product or major aspect of a product or several small products, including budget, timeline, and quality.
  • Develop and implement strategic production plans, potentially incorporating agile methodologies for flexibility and responsiveness.
  • Oversee and manage one or multiple production teams, ensuring effective collaboration and resource allocation.
  • Drive key decision-making processes, resolving complex issues and mitigating risks.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement and accountability within the production teams.
  • Manage communication with executive leadership and other key stakeholders, providing regular updates on project progress and challenges.
  • Mentor and develop Producers and other production staff, helping them grow their skills and leadership capabilities.
  • Evaluate and recommend tools and technologies to enhance production efficiency, including advanced project management software that supports agile practices.
  • Manage external relationships with vendors and partners at a strategic level.
  • Help define and manage team structure, recruitment, and staffing needs to ensure the team has the necessary skills and capacity.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for project status, providing clear, concise, and regular updates to executive stakeholders, external partners, and publishing teams.

Skills, Knowledge & Abilities

  • Advanced English Proficiency
  • Technical and soft skills: Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills. Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities. Expertise in managing complex projects and multiple teams. Ability to drive accountability and foster a collaborative environment. Deep understanding of agile principles and their application at a strategic level.
  • Decision-making & problem-solving skills: Expert at making high-impact decisions under pressure. Ability to identify and address root causes of complex issues across the entire product lifecycle. Exceptional risk management and mitigation skills.
  • Tools & technology: Mastery of project management tools and methodologies, including those that support agile at scale. Ability to evaluate and implement new technologies to improve production workflows.
  • Deep understanding of the game development process and product lifecycle. Extensive knowledge of market trends, player behavior, and business drivers. Ability to have strategic discussions with all disciplines, including Product, Design, Art, Engineering, Marketing, and Business Development.

Education & Experience

  • Suggested Educational Background: A bachelor's or master's degree in a relevant field such as game design, production, business administration, or a related management discipline. MBA is a plus.
  • Minimum years of relevant experience: 7+ years or equivalent experience in game development production, with a significant portion in senior leadership or management roles. Proven track record of successfully leading and delivering complex projects.

Working Conditions

  • May require extended hours during release periods
  • Remote

Overview

CrossCountry Mortgage (CCM) is the nation's number one distributed retail mortgage lender with more than 7,000 employees operating over 700 branches and servicing loans across all 50 states, D.C. and Puerto Rico. Our company has been recognized ten times on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private businesses and has received many awards for our standout culture.

A culture where you can grow! CCM has created an exceptional culture driving employee engagement, exceeding employee expectations, and directly impacting company success. At our core, our entrepreneurial spirit empowers every employee to be who they are to help us move forward together. You\'ll get unwavering support from all departments and total transparency from the top down.

CCM offers eligible employees a competitive compensation plan and a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, as well as a 401K. We also offer company-provided short-term disability, an employee assistance program, and a wellness program.

Position Overview

The Loan Officer Assistant position supports the Melville, NY office of CrossCountry Mortgage. The Loan Officer Assistant is responsible for accurately setting up new purchase applications, issuing pre-approval letters, processing and disclosing loans, and overseeing the success of every loan from contract to close. The Loan Officer Assistant will work with Borrowers, Loan Officers, Underwriters, and any Third Parties to close 95% of all loans on time while providing an outstanding experience from application to closing.

This position operates within Eastern Standard Time Zone working hours to support the East Coast region.

Job Responsibilities

  • Serve as Primary contact and liaison between clients, Branch Manager, Branch Sales Manager and/or assigned Loan Originator(s).
  • Contact all borrower(s) within 24 hours after the LO appointment, fully review the loan applications and other documents with borrowers and effectively communicate all pre-approval parameters to borrowers.
  • Request and review the cash, credit, and income qualifications of all borrowers.
  • Review documentation received within 24 hours of receipt for discrepancies, omissions, verified income calculation, asset verification and Encompass updates based on verified information; immediately notify Loan Originators when any discrepancies are found on documentation. Track all requested documents in Encompass.
  • Communicate any red flags or major potential issues to the LO or Team Captain (if applicable) and Realtor partner and ensure understanding of all required conditions before contacting borrowers or third parties.
  • Meet deadlines (loan documents to title 3 days before closing) while maintaining multiple assignments/projects.
  • Handle all payment scenario requests.
  • Accurately pre-approve all borrowers and supplement the pre-approval letter with any pertinent documents (i.e., Pre-Approval Addendum, completed All About You form, etc.). Rush pre-approval requests when necessary.
  • Provide a courtesy phone call to the referring Realtor within 24 hours of issuance, ensuring they fully understand any important details of the pre-approval. Communicate effectively to all respective Realtor partners with updates as needed.
  • Accurately onboard all newly received contracts for Rate Lock consultation.
  • Expeditiously submit and disclose the loan application to remain TRID compliant.
  • Provide outstanding Borrower Tuesday Updates, Pre-Closing, and Funding Calls (if applicable).
  • Ensure 95% of all loans close on time with a mandatory daily gauge check to address choke points.
  • Attend weekly pipeline calls to handle 95% of all loan problems before escalating to the LO and ensure all required time-to-task objectives are met.
  • Provide excellent customer service both internally and externally.
  • Available to work varying hours and overtime if needed.

Qualifications and Skills

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • Minimum 3 years\' current conventional fixed and ARM, HELOC and construction mortgage loan processing or origination experience.
  • State and Federal NMLS License preferred.
  • Experience in Mortgage Loan Processing.
  • Experience with RESPA and mortgage and consumer lending regulations and loan documents, preferred.
  • Working knowledge of all major investors\' guidelines.
  • Experience with Encompass.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Skill in utilizing text messaging platforms effectively.
  • Excellent prioritization skills to meet established deadlines and KPIs.
  • Skill in analyzing cash, credit and income to ensure accurate pre-approval.
  • Proficient in DU, LP, Microsoft Office & Windows and ability to adapt to new technologies.

Pay Range

  • Hourly Rate: $28.00 - $30.00
  • This position is bonus plan eligible.

The posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

title: Coordenador de Vendas B2B
description:
Overview

Solveplan é a principal consultoria SAP da América Latina especializada em Planejamento Orçamentário, Consolidação Societária e Analytics , com foco nas soluções SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Business Data Cloud e Group Reporting . Somos reconhecidos pelos clientes como uma consultoria de nicho altamente especializada, que entrega valor estratégico. Estamos em busca de um Coordenador Comercial para apoiar e impulsionar nossos processos comerciais, garantindo previsibilidade e eficiência operacional.

Responsabilidades

  • Gestão do pipeline e forecast: manter processos comerciais organizados, assegurando visibilidade e previsibilidade das oportunidades em andamento.
  • Orquestração do time comercial: acompanhar a atuação de Executivos Comerciais e SDR, garantindo fluidez entre prospecção, qualificação e fechamento.
  • Integração com Marketing: trabalhar em conjunto com Marketing para alinhar ICP, estratégias de Account-Based Marketing (ABM) e passagem estruturada de leads qualificados para vendas.
  • Gestão de indicadores comerciais: acompanhar, consolidar e alimentar relatórios de performance comercial, oferecendo visibilidade para a diretoria.
  • Suporte à expansão de contas: apoiar executivos comerciais na identificação de oportunidades de upsell/cross-sell em clientes da base, em colaboração com o time de Customer Success.
  • Alinhamento Comercial → Operações (S&OP): conduzir o processo de alinhamento periódico entre área comercial e operações, garantindo que a empresa tenha visibilidade antecipada das demandas de projetos em maturação no pipeline, facilitando o planejamento de recursos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência em gestão comercial B2B, preferencialmente em consultoria de tecnologia ou serviços complexos.
  • Forte domínio em processos de vendas consultivas, com atuação em ciclos de venda longos e contas estratégicas.
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos, organizar rotinas e transformar dados comerciais em informações para tomada de decisão.
  • Experiência em processos de alinhamento entre área comercial e operações (S&OP), garantindo previsibilidade de entregas.
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado a resultados, com habilidade de comunicação clara e gestão de prioridades.
  • Desejável experiência prévia em consultoria SAP.

Informações adicionais

  • Oportunidade remota.

#VemSerOC

Pioneiro no país em gestão de serviços oncológicos, a Oncoclínicas&Co foi fundada em 2010 e hoje é um dos maiores centros de oncologia, hematologia e radioterapia da América Latina.

Na essência da Oncoclínicas&Co , o paciente é o centro de tudo. É para ele que buscamos os mais avançados tratamentos e o mais alto nível de qualidade e segurança. Aqui na OC valorizamos a diversidade e buscamos promover uma cultura inclusiva onde as pessoas se sintam pertencentes. Acreditamos que a inovação nasce de um ambiente diverso, com diferentes perspectivas e vivências.

title: Sales Development Representative, Deel IT | LATAM
description:
Summary

Deel IT exists to equip the world's talent with the means to do their best work. Through one slick platform customers can procure, deploy, repair & recover entire fleets of devices and home office equipment for their employees in over 130 countries.

As our Sales Development Representative (SDR) for Deel IT , you’ll play a vital role in our team by opening doors to new and existing opportunities by building strong relationships across all levels of our target customer segments. You’ll contribute directly to our growth, creating a significant impact in the company’s journey. This position will give you the chance to collaborate with our sales team, conduct market research to identify potential customers, work to expand current business, and qualify leads through insightful conversations about device and equipment management.

Please note: This role requires that you reside within Latin America (LATAM) and are fluent in both English and Spanish.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive Growth: Fuel our company’s growth by generating high-quality outbound leads (both new business and existing business) that can convert into meaningful sales opportunities and business wins.
  • Collaborate & Learn: Work alongside a seasoned sales team to build out our world-class Sales Playbook and Tech Stack, while sharing your insights to make these resources even better.
  • Engage & Educate: Engage leads through various channels—phone, email, events, webinars, and campaigns—to educate them and build interest in our solutions.
  • Master the Process: Develop a deep understanding of each stage in the lead generation process, from marketing initiatives and touchpoints to the transition of leads to an Account Executive.
  • Build & Refine Outreach: Create targeted email sequences and confidently reach out via cold calls to identify key contacts, establish relationships, and deepen connections.
  • Follow Through: Conduct timely follow-ups to nurture relationships and set up valuable meetings with our Account Executives.

What We’re Looking For

  • Fluency: in both English and Spanish.
  • Growth-Oriented: You have a proactive approach and thrive in a fast-paced environment with a strong growth mindset.
  • Strong Communicator: You’re skilled at crafting messages that resonate and have experience writing emails and campaign copy that converts.
  • Team Player: You’re a natural relationship-builder who collaborates well with both internal and external teams, bringing fresh ideas to improve processes and communication.
  • Adaptable & Curious: You enjoy learning, embrace change, and are eager to evolve in a dynamic work environment.

Bonus Points (Not Required)

  • Experience in HR, Fintech, IT or related fields
  • Background in a fast-growing startup
  • Previous experience in a remote or distributed team

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you! These qualities are essential for success in this role, so please apply if you’re excited to bring these skills to our team and grow with us. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and are looking for passionate individuals ready to make an impact.

Want to stand out? We encourage you to prospect us! Reach out to the hiring team to let us know you’ve applied—show us your skills in action and demonstrate your proactive approach to building connections.

Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all.

Some things you’ll enjoy

  • Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location
  • Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country
  • The flexibility of remote work, including optional WeWork access

At Deel, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy or maternity or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Reporting to the Vice President, Global GTM Enablement & AI Strategy, you'll drive the systems, processes, and content that enable our field teams to effectively engage customers and drive growth. This role puts you at the intersection of technology, strategy, and people development - where you'll leverage cutting-edge AI solutions and data-driven insights to scale enablement across our global organization. You'll collaborate directly with our CRO and executive leadership team, making this role critical to GitLab's go-to-market success. As part of our team, you will help shape one of Microsoft’s fastest-growing cloud services. Your work will directly impact Copilot, enabling personalized, context-aware experiences that empower millions of users across Microsoft 365.

Do you want to collaborate closely with software engineers, product managers, and researchers to design, implement, and evaluate models and algorithms that continuously adapt and improve based on user interactions and feedback? Do you want to leverage advanced machine learning and information retrieval to predict and optimize memory content selection, representation, and lifecycle management?

You will work at the forefront of applied AI and machine learning, shaping the future of intelligent productivity tools. You will contribute to a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and experimentation.

The Substrate Core Substrate team powers the infrastructure that underpins Microsoft 365’s most critical services and Copilot. We are a high-impact, forward-looking team focused on building intelligent, scalable, and cost-efficient platforms that enable Microsoft to deliver world-class productivity experiences to billions of users. Our mission is to drive operational excellence and innovation across the M365 fleet by leveraging AI, automation, and deep platform integration.

Your core mission will be to deliver exciting innovation in Microsoft Copilot. Microsoft Copilot is revolutionizing how people work and have created an unprecedented opportunity to advance the state-of-the-art in a way that benefits millions of people.

More About Your Responsibilities

We are seeking candidates with research skills and the desire to pursue the cutting edge in model development that pushes technological boundaries. We are looking for candidates with interest and experience in language model training, large language model evaluation, and quality assessment. In particular we would like a candidate that has a passion for understanding what makes an AI solution work and how to measure its performance.

We are looking for candidates who are creative, self-driven, curious, people-oriented and comfortable defining a path through ambiguity towards high-level goals. The successful applicants will collaborate closely with people across Microsoft’s product teams and Microsoft Research to see their ideas realized in products and services that are used worldwide, as well as to contribute back to the scientific community and beyond (e.g. via presentations, publications, media interviews, and similar). Come to define, design, and deliver what enterprise cloud productivity means.

As a Data Scientist , you will help transform how Copilot features are evaluated and improved. Your team will deliver end-to-end experimentation, evaluation, and insights to Copilot engineers, PMs, and fellow scientists. You’ll work on the data generation platform that creates algorithms and ML pipelines for simulating user actions and datasets that reflect real-world usage and user preferences and develop metrics that go beyond accuracy – capturing nuance, intent, and satisfaction. You’ll work on scalable pipelines that support offline evaluations for Copilot Search, BizChat, Connectors, and Agents (DAs). This opportunity will allow you to dive deep into Copilot technologies, shape how AI quality is measured at scale, build critical skills in the AI-era, and rapidly grow your career.

By applying to this position, you will be considered for multiple similar positions within our organization for an invitation-only virtual interview day. Position specifics, including hiring team, location, and position details, will be determined following the interview process.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and evaluate ML models using prepared datasets, customer feedback, and novel training/fine-tuning algorithms for language models.
  • Write production-quality code, apply debugging best practices, and stay current with industry trends.
  • Drive customer-centric solutions by aligning with business goals and managing stakeholder expectations.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to define success metrics and improve AI quality at scale.
  • Lead research projects that yield new algorithms, tools, or insights solving open problems.
  • Analyze evaluation outputs to identify gaps in coverage, quality, and usability.
  • Design experiments, define metrics, and develop ML pipelines for encoder-decoder and cross-encoder models, semantic search, and user intent understanding.
  • Work with large-scale data while championing privacy and compliance.
  • Engage with customers and internal teams to identify pain points and drive impactful improvements.
  • Stay engaged with the latest research and foster a strong applied science culture. Publishing is encouraged.

Qualifications

Main qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in predictive analytics, statistics, or research.

Overview

Are you a socially conscious, dedicated individual who is committed to building a better future for children, families, and their communities? If so, join us as we support early childhood education programs across the country to create positive outcomes for the children and families served.

Are you a strategic leader with a passion for growth, innovation, and transforming the landscape of early childhood education? We are looking for a dynamic Project Director to drive our mission to eliminate the gaps between young children’s potential and their success in school and life.

Why Acelero?

Our mission is bold: To design and deliver research and evidence-based approaches to eliminate the gaps between young childrenʼs inherent potential and their achievement in school and life. With our partners, we accelerate child and family outcomes that honor all of the aspirations and cultures of the communities we serve.

Our values: Data-Informed Learning; Transparent & Open Communication; Growth Mindset; Championing Equality; Caring Teams & Communities.

Your Role

As the Project Director for North Carolina Family Child Care Network (FCCN) you will be responsible for increasing family and community engagement; increasing provider quality rating assessment scores; and providing a learning environment for family child care home providers to enhance their professional growth - and deliver high quality early care and education. The foundation provides leadership and operational oversight for partners, Shine’s direct service, and subcontractors on this project. This role requires a highly organized, systems-oriented leader with demonstrated experience in budget management, project execution, and strategic collaboration. The Project Director oversees the day-to-day implementation, ensures alignment with project goals, timelines, and deliverables. The Project Director is responsible for coordinating across partners and subcontractors, managing direct and indirect staff, and ensuring the use of data to deliver high-quality communities of practice, coaching, and technical assistance. The Project Director will also serve as the primary liaison to state and local partners, ensuring the foundation’s work is aligned with North Carolina’s early childhood system priorities.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the planning, execution, and oversight of all project initiatives, ensuring alignment with deliverables, timelines, and performance metrics.

  • Serve as the primary liaison between The Acelero Foundation, Shine, North Carolina’s Division of Child Development and Early Education, community partners, and subcontracted partners.

  • Establish and maintain collaborative relationships with statewide, regional, and local stakeholders.

  • Develop detailed project schedules, task assignments, and milestone trackers in collaboration with Shine and subcontractor teams.

  • Facilitate project and partner meetings to monitor progress, address barriers, and ensure accountability across all partners, while providing regular updates to funders and internal leadership.

  • Monitor expenses and adjust financial plans as needed to meet project and contract obligations.

  • Contribute to the growth of the Acelero Foundation.

  • Use data to drive decisions and produce reports that highlight effective practices and areas for improvement.

  • Represents Shine and the project at state and local meetings.

  • Monitor progress towards deliverables including parent and provider awareness, parent and provider participation, and advocacy.

  • Provides thought leadership in statewide planning and the evolution of North Carolina’s Family Child Care Network supports and infrastructure.

  • Develop and submit reports, data dashboards, and presentations to funders and leadership.

  • Support integration of communities of practice, self-directed learning, and one-on-one coaching for FCC providers

  • Oversees the dissemination of family and community engagement resources and materials to licensed FCC providers

  • Tracks and oversees the delivery of face-to-face and virtual parent/guardian education training sessions to increase parent awareness and advocacy

  • Facilitates problem-solving and peer learning across the statewide network.

  • Evaluates the progress and participate in the process of continuous improvement utilizing both data and observations

  • Participates in assigned meetings, events and training as required.

Where: North Carolina remote with 20% travel

How Much: This position pays up to $105,000 annually.

We are hiring multiple Data Scientists across LATAM to join the Microsoft 365 team. These are remote positions, allowing you to work from the comfort of your home! As part of our team, you will help shape one of Microsoft’s fastest-growing cloud services. Your work will directly impact Copilot, enabling personalized, context-aware experiences that empower millions of users across Microsoft 365. Do you want to collaborate closely with software engineers, product managers, and researchers to design, implement, and evaluate models and algorithms that continuously adapt and improve based on user interactions and feedback? Do you want to leverage advanced machine learning and information retrieval to predict and optimize memory content selection, representation, and lifecycle management?

You will work at the forefront of applied AI and machine learning, shaping the future of intelligent productivity tools. You will contribute to a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and experimentation.

The Substrate Core Substrate team powers the infrastructure that underpins Microsoft 365’s most critical services and Copilot. We are a high-impact, forward-looking team focused on building intelligent, scalable, and cost-efficient platforms that enable Microsoft to deliver world-class productivity experiences to billions of users. Our mission is to drive operational excellence and innovation across the M365 fleet by leveraging AI, automation, and deep platform integration.

Your core mission will be to deliver exciting innovation in Microsoft Copilot. Microsoft Copilot is revolutionizing how people work and have created an unprecedented opportunity to advance the state-of-the-art in a way that benefits millions of people.

More About Your Responsibilities

We are seeking candidates with research skills and the desire to pursue the cutting edge in model development that pushes technological boundaries. We are looking for candidates with interest and experience in language model training, large language model evaluation, and quality assessment. In particular we would like a candidate that has a passion for understanding what makes an AI solution work and how to measure its performance. We are looking for candidates who are creative, self-driven, curious, people-oriented and comfortable defining a path through ambiguity towards high-level goals. The successful applicants will collaborate closely with people across Microsoft’s product teams and Microsoft Research to see their ideas realized in products and services that are used worldwide, as well as to contribute back to the scientific community and beyond (e.g. via presentations, publications, media interviews, and similar). Come to define, design, and deliver what enterprise cloud productivity means.

As a Data Scientist , you will help transform how Copilot features are evaluated and improved. Your team will deliver end-to-end experimentation, evaluation, and insights to Copilot engineers, PMs, and fellow scientists. You’ll work on the data generation platform that creates algorithms and ML pipelines for simulating user actions and datasets that reflect real-world usage and user preferences and develop metrics that go beyond accuracy – capturing nuance, intent, and satisfaction. You’ll work on scalable pipelines that support offline evaluations for Copilot Search, BizChat, Connectors, and Agents (DAs). This opportunity will allow you to dive deep into Copilot technologies, shape how AI quality is measured at scale, build critical skills in the AI-era, and rapidly grow your career.

By applying to this position, you will be considered for multiple similar positions within our organization for an invitation-only virtual interview day. Position specifics, including hiring team, location, and position details, will be determined following the interview process.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and evaluate ML models using prepared datasets, customer feedback, and novel training/fine-tuning algorithms for language models.
  • Write production-quality code, apply debugging best practices, and stay current with industry trends.
  • Drive customer-centric solutions by aligning with business goals and managing stakeholder expectations.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to define success metrics and improve AI quality at scale.
  • Lead research projects that yield new algorithms, tools, or insights solving open problems.
  • Analyze evaluation outputs to identify gaps in coverage, quality, and usability.
  • Design experiments, define metrics, and develop ML pipelines for encoder-decoder and cross-encoder models, semantic search, and user intent understanding.
  • Work with large-scale data while championing privacy and compliance.
  • Engage with customers and internal teams to identify pain points and drive impactful improvements.
  • Stay engaged with the latest research and foster a strong applied science culture. Publishing is encouraged.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in predictive analytics, statistics, or research.
  • Experience with synthetic data generation and data management for evaluation/training.
  • At least one year of experience publishing patents or peer-reviewed papers.
  • Deep motivation for user-centric AI and interest in human cognition, memory, and AI.
  • Global collaboration is integral to our work at Microsoft, and proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience with large-scale embedding models and transformer architectures.
  • Familiarity with reinforcement learning and distributed computing platforms (e.g., Heron, AML, Euclid).
  • Proficient analytical skills and experience with telemetry and performance metrics.
  • DevOps experience and cloud services knowledge (Azure preferred).
  • Agile development experience and a structured approach to software design.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Growth mindset with resilience and a passion for learning.
  • Commitment to diversity, inclusion, and authentic collaboration.
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to engage diverse audiences.
  • Ownership mindset with the ability to deliver results and manage expectations.
  • Self-motivated and collaborative across teams and organizations.

description:
Software Engineering Manager - Container and Virtualisation Infrastructure

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Container and Virtualisation Infrastructure role at Canonical

Software Engineering Manager - Container and Virtualisation Infrastructure

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Container and Virtualisation Infrastructure role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
Our mission is to build a next-generation private cloud infrastructure, combining KVM, Ceph, and SDN technologies to create a data center scale cloud that 'just works' and provides a mission-critical cloud for edge and core enterprise deployments. We're hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality microservice architectures and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux kernel, virtualisation, storage and networking.
LXD components span the entire software stack from low-level kernel features to the upper level management API/CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.
As an engineering manager at Canonical you must have a solid technical background, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
The successful candidate will have experience leading successful, collaborative engineering teams, and demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems and deep knowledge of Linux.
Location : This is a remote position available in EMEA and the Americas.
What you will focus on

  • Lead a team of remote engineers
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Participate in the engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Engage with teams at Canonical, the open source community and partners
  • Work from home with global travel for 4 to 6 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You understand modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8s
  • You love developing and growing people and have a strong track record of doing it
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have strong written and verbal technical communication skills
  • You have experience programming in C and/or Go.
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Sobre a Empresa

A Fundação José Silveira (FJS) é uma instituição privada, sem fins lucrativos, com quase nove décadas de história. Reconhecida como de utilidade pública, atua fortemente nas áreas de saúde, ensino, pesquisa e projetos socioambientais , sempre pautada pelo compromisso social e pela transparência na gestão de recursos públicos.

Com sede em Salvador e atuação em diversas regiões do Estado, a FJS é referência no Terceiro Setor , conduzindo contratos em parceria com órgãos públicos das esferas municipal, estadual e federal.

Cultura e Equipe

A cultura organizacional é guiada por valores como ética, responsabilidade social, inovação e excelência em gestão . A Fundação valoriza o trabalho colaborativo, estimulando a troca de conhecimento entre diferentes áreas, a capacitação contínua e o fortalecimento das equipes.

Na Controladoria, o ambiente é dinâmico e desafiador, reunindo profissionais comprometidos com a conformidade contábil e legal e com a missão institucional da FJS. A área de Prestação de Contas atua como elo estratégico entre contabilidade, faturamento, jurídico e setores técnicos, assegurando a rastreabilidade e a integridade das informações.

Sobre a Vaga

Garantir conformidade na aplicação e prestação de contas dos recursos públicos, atendendo às exigências legais, contratuais e dos órgãos fiscalizadores.

Supervisionar e orientar a equipe , assegurando qualidade, prazos e integridade das informações.

Coordenar processos contábeis e financeiros , incluindo encerramento do exercício e publicação das demonstrações.

Atuar de forma estratégica , elaborando relatórios gerenciais, indicadores e apoiando a tomada de decisão.

Representar a área em auditorias , prestando esclarecimentos técnicos.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Supervisionar a equipe responsável pela elaboração e análise das prestações de contas financeiras e técnicas, assegurando conformidade com os contratos de gestão, convênios, termos de colaboração e demais instrumentos firmados com entes públicos das esferas municipal, estadual e federal.
  • Coordenar a organização, validação e arquivamento da documentação comprobatória da aplicação dos recursos públicos (notas fiscais, recibos, folhas de pagamento, extratos bancários, relatórios de execução e comprovantes de recolhimento de encargos sociais, etc.).
  • Acompanhar a escrituração e análise dos registros contábeis relacionados às prestações de contas, assegurando a consistência das informações lançadas e a correta vinculação às rubricas contratuais.
  • Coordenar os processos de encerramento do exercício contábil e garantir a adequada elaboração e publicação das demonstrações contábeis dos contratos, em conformidade com as normas vigentes e exigências contratuais e legais.
  • Controlar os prazos de entrega das prestações de contas e relatórios contábeis, garantindo atendimento às cláusulas contratuais e legislações aplicáveis.
  • Atuar como elo entre a área de prestação de contas e os setores de contabilidade, faturamento, suprimentos, jurídico e assistência, assegurando a rastreabilidade e integridade dos dados.
  • Fornecer orientação técnica à equipe e às unidades executoras quanto à correta aplicação dos recursos públicos e ao atendimento das demandas dos órgãos fiscalizadores.
  • Elaborar e apresentar relatórios gerenciais e indicadores de desempenho, oferecendo suporte à tomada de decisão estratégica e à melhoria contínua dos processos de controle institucional.
  • Representar a área perante auditorias internas e externas, prestando esclarecimentos técnicos sempre que necessário.
  • Manter-se atualizado e disseminar à equipe a legislação e normas aplicáveis ao Terceiro Setor e à gestão de recursos públicos.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação acadêmica: Bacharelado em Ciências Contábeis.
  • Experiência: Vivência prévia em supervisão ou coordenação de equipes; experiência mínima de 3 a 5 anos em rotinas contábeis e prestação de contas, preferencialmente no Terceiro Setor ou em instituições que atuem em parcerias com o poder público.
  • Conhecimentos técnicos: Legislação e normas contábeis; Legislação e normas de gestão de recursos públicos e Terceiro Setor; Domínio do Pacote Office (nível intermediário/avançado em Excel); Conhecimento de sistemas de gestão contábil e financeira (ERP); Desejável domínio de plataformas de prestação de contas e relatórios físico-financeiros.

Habilidades e Competências

  • Liderança e capacidade de coordenação de equipes multidisciplinares.

  • Capacidade analítica para interpretação de documentos contábeis, financeiros e legais.
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita, com habilidade para interface institucional.
  • Proatividade, visão sistêmica e habilidade de negociação.

title: Head of Customer Success and Implementation
description:
About Pear Suite

Pear Suite is a mission-driven healthcare technology company transforming how community-based care is delivered. Our platform empowers community health workers, doulas, and other frontline providers with tools to coordinate care, track outcomes, and improve health equity. We partner with organizations serving Medicaid and Medicare populations, delivering social and preventive care at scale.

Why Pear Suite?

We're a mission-driven team committed to health equity and innovation in community-based care. You'll thrive here if you're eager to take initiative, value autonomy, and enjoy building structure where none exists. Join us to build scalable, human-centered technology that empowers frontline workers and improves lives across the U.S.

About the role

We\'re seeking a Head of Customer Success and Implementation to lead how we deliver, support, and grow our customer partnerships. You will own the full customer journey—from onboarding and implementation to adoption, retention, and expansion. This is both a strategic and hands-on role: you\'ll design scalable processes, lead customer-facing teams, and directly engage with our most important partners to ensure they achieve measurable impact with Pear Suite.

What you\'ll do

  • Lead the Customer Success and Implementation functions, building the strategy, playbooks, and processes for a rapidly scaling healthcare SaaS platform.
  • Oversee new customer onboarding and implementation projects, ensuring timely and successful go-lives.
  • Drive adoption, engagement, and measurable outcomes across Pear Suite\'s customer base.
  • Establish KPIs for retention, expansion, NPS, and time-to-value.
  • Serve as executive sponsor for key customers, building strong, trust-based relationships with senior leaders at partner organizations.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Sales to ensure customer feedback informs roadmap and delivery.
  • Build and mentor a high-performing Customer Success and Implementation team, fostering career growth and development.
  • Develop scalable processes, tools, and systems to support a growing, diverse customer base.
  • Provide regular reporting and insights to the executive team and Board on customer health, retention, and revenue impact.
  • Manage escalations and ensure quick, empathetic resolution of customer issues.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in Customer Success, Implementation, or related functions, ideally in SaaS.
  • At least 3 years of leadership experience managing customer-facing teams in healthcare or healthtech or community based groups.
  • Demonstrated success in scaling customer success/implementation functions in a high-growth startup.
  • Strong background in implementation project management, with a proven ability to deliver on time and within scope.
  • Deep knowledge of SaaS metrics (retention, NRR, churn, time-to-value, etc.) and how to improve them.
  • Experience supporting Medicaid/Medicare-focused organizations, provider groups, or community-based organizations strongly preferred.
  • Ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on execution.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to make complex workflows and data clear to diverse stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain strong executive-level relationships with customers.
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity, creating structure, and driving outcomes in fast-changing environments.
  • Experience with CRM, CS, and project management tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, Asana, etc.).
  • MBA, PMP, or similar credentials are a plus.

What we offer

  • The compensation range for this position is $140,000-$180,000
  • A mission driven culture that values innovation, collaboration and growth
  • Fully Remote
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Health and Wellness Stipend
  • Tech Stipend
  • Co-working Stipend

Sobre a Just a Little Data / B>P

Só um pouquinho de dados. Ou um montão deles.

A quantidade não é o mais importante, mas sim o uso que fazemos das informações. Na Just a Little Data, nosso papel é exatamente este: ajudar empresas - sejam elas multinacionais ou negócios locais - a potencializar o conhecimento por trás dos dados.

Para isso, contamos não só com um time feito de especialistas em business, tecnologia, comunicação e outras áreas, mas com toda a estrutura e apoio do grupo B&Partners , do qual fazemos parte.

Queremos revolucionar o processo de tomada de decisão nas empresas e tornar a ciência de dados mais acessível, para que ela seja uma vantagem competitiva de negócios de diversos segmentos.

Nosso clima é de startup, com desafios, projetos e oportunidades de desenvolvimento constantes. Valorizamos a criatividade, unicidade de bagagem, bem estar e autonomia das pessoas que atuam conosco. Afinal, são elas que fazem a empresa, e não o contrário. Se curtiu a ideia de somar com a gente, veja nossas vagas em aberto - uma delas pode ser a sua cara. E o seu perfil, a nossa.

Missão

Solucionar problemas e direcionar operações com tecnologia e ciência de dados da maneira mais prática e objetiva visando aumentar os resultados dos nossos clientes e parceiros.

Inquietude: tudo sempre pode melhorar;

Conhecimento profundo do que faz;

Comprometimento e transparência nas relações (B2B e B2C);

Assertividade e precisão na entrega.

Diversidade

Aqui na Just, respeitar as identidades e valores de cada indivíduo não é só uma questão fundamental, mas obrigatória. Acreditamos que contar com pessoas de todos os tipos no nosso time é exatamente o que precisamos para nos desenvolver em todos os sentidos. Por isso, diferentes visões, bagagens e modos de ser são e serão sempre bem-vindos na nossa casa.

Como parte do grupo, somos signatários do Pacto Global da ONU, e lideramos dois importantes movimentos: Elas Lideram 2030 e Raça é Prioridade. Isso se traduz em metas claras: 50% de lideranças femininas e 50% de pessoas negras em posições de liderança, reforçando nosso compromisso com equidade real e contínua.

Somos uma empresa de tecnologia com um equilíbrio que nos orgulha! Aqui, mulheres são maioria, provando que inovação e diversidade caminham juntas.

Bora somar e deixar os gráficos abaixo cada vez menos padronizados!

Nossa forma de trabalhar

Nossa forma de trabalhar é híbrida, mais para remota. Na Just, valorizamos o equilíbrio entre autonomia e alinhamento. Por isso, temos vagas remotas, híbridas e algumas que pedem presença em São Paulo, seja para encontros no escritório ou momentos conforme o escopo da vaga exigir. Mas não se preocupe, tudo isso é sinalizado de forma clara na descrição do cargo e ao longo do processo seletivo.

Se estiver em SP, conte com um espaço físico, moderno e bem equipado. Seja na sua casa ou na nossa, o que importa é se sentir bem no dia a dia!

A gente sabe que para ter os melhores talentos ao nosso lado, um bom salário não é a única coisa que importa. Por isso, preparamos um pacote de benefícios completo para oferecer mais bem estar e qualidade de vida para todo time da Just! Confira os principais

title: Head of High Touch Customer Success
description:
Overview

Head of High Touch Customer Success

Hi, I'm Casey - Head of Dedicated Customer Success at Ashby; I look after our upmarket customers in the Strategic and High Touch segments. One of my favorite aspects of Ashby is our operating principle of Continuous Improvement. Coupled with our principle of caring deeply about our customers, we often find ourselves wondering 'what is a better way to accomplish this'. That's why I am thrilled to be hiring my backfill: the Head of High Touch Customer Success!

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to elevate the customer experience to the next level. You'll join our Dedicated CSM leadership team, working alongside our Heads of Strategic and EMEA Customer Success, as well as leaders from our Startup CS, Support, Customer Education and Contract Management teams.

About the Role

As Head of High Touch Customer Success, you'll play a critical role in ensuring our customers continue to have an exceptional experience with Ashby as we scale. You'll grow a talented team of CSMs, lead the current Manager of High Touch Customer Success (a recent internal promotion), and drive the overall strategy and execution of our High Touch CS function.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead and coach both the current Manager of High Touch CS and your own team of CSMs supporting customers across onboarding, adoption, and long-term partnership
  • Drive process improvements across the customer journey, with a focus on post-onboarding and adoption
  • Help evolve how we deliver consistent, high-quality customer experiences at scale
  • Serve as a key product advocate - partnering closely with internal teams to champion improvements that better support our upper mid-market and lower enterprise customers

Role requirements

  • Team Leadership & Coaching : You have experience leading and developing Customer Success Managers in a B2B SaaS environment. You know how to foster a culture of empathy, accountability, and continuous growth.
  • Customer Journey Expertise : You understand the customer lifecycle and have helped improve onboarding, adoption, and retention through thoughtful, repeatable approaches.
  • Operational Mindset : You've helped implement and improve team processes, and you bring a structured lens to scaling what works while staying adaptable.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration : You're comfortable partnering with teams like Sales, Product, and Support to align around customer needs and elevate the experience.
  • Problem-Solving Orientation : You don't rely on "what worked before" - you're thoughtful, pragmatic, and eager to find solutions that fit the unique needs of your team and customers.
  • Data-Driven : You are comfortable using data and metrics to drive decision-making, continually improving both the team and customer experience.
  • Customer-First Thinking : You have a deep understanding of B2B customer needs and have a history of ensuring outstanding support experiences.
  • Lifecycle Awareness : You're familiar with key stages like onboarding and adoption, and you've supported efforts that drive product engagement and help customers achieve their goals.

You'll Be a Great Fit If You:

  • You demonstrate clear communication. You ask clarifying questions with precision and can distill complex concepts into simple themes.
  • You are a great listener. You see your role as 1) Advocate for the Customer Success Team as well as 2) Voice of the customer to internal stakeholders so we can ensure that our product roadmap continues to evolve.
  • You are a problem solver. You thrive at solving complex challenges with innovative, scalable solutions.
  • You know process matters. You are eager to improve processes and workflows to enhance efficiency and efficacy.
  • Your peers describe you as detail oriented. You take pride in internal operations.
  • You're an advocate for the team. We'll be looking for your help when it comes to defining resourcing and headcount planning.
  • You love to coach. You see every teaching moment as an opportunity and are excited to help teams grow.

You Might Not Be a Fit If:

  • You prefer an in-person role over remote.
  • You're not eager to roll up your sleeves and get into the weeds (e.g. call shadowing isn't interesting to you).
  • You are accustomed to defining ideas and strategies, yet not responsible for their execution.
  • You thrive in environments where you lead a simple, established product rather than a dynamic, evolving one.
  • You prefer exclusively to build (rather than build, iterate, optimize)

Our Philosophy

Here are a few key points (relevant to the go-to-market side) that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

  • We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is a lot easier to sell.
  • We want to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers.
  • We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people (and the right work environment) deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount. We hire and compensate accordingly.

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we'll get into these and other values during the hiring process.

The Interview

At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. Our interview process is structured to get to know you and your career as well as empower you with insight into our key focus areas. Here is the process in its entirety:

  • 30 min - Recruiter Screen
  • 60 min - Hiring Manager Interview with Global Head of Dedicated CS
  • 60 min - Presentation & Interview with our Manager of High Touch, Head of Startup & Head of Strategic
  • Final Round:
  • 30 min - Interview with VP of Customer Success
  • 30 min - Interview with CEO
  • 10 min - Closing Questions with Hiring Manager

Benefits

  • You'll get the time to do things the right way; we put a lot of emphasis on high quality work and avoid quick hacks as much as possible.
  • You get to represent a product that our prospects & customers are truly excited about.
  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn't feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby - do it when you feel financially comfortable.
  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks is recommended per year. Expect "Vacation?" in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it
  • Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.
  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval
  • Extended health benefits for you and your dependents (subject to availability with our Employer of Record)
  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Overview

Transformar a vida das pessoas através de inovação e tecnologia, este é o nosso propósito. Estamos procurando um(a) Pessoa Engenheira de Dados que queira impulsionar a inovação conosco.

Somos um Instituto de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento com um time incrível, ambiente descontraído e espírito colaborativo. Valorizamos as pessoas e promovemos um ambiente de desenvolvimento, destacando a nossa cultura de Atlantes. Estamos entre as melhores empresas de TI para se trabalhar no Brasil, segundo o ranking GPTW.

Formação Acadêmica

  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Ciência de Dados ou área relacionada.
  • Pós-graduação, Mestrado ou Doutorado é desejável.

Responsabilidades

  • Colaborar com clientes para entender suas necessidades de dados e desenvolver soluções para extrair, transformar, armazenar e exibir dados.
  • Pesquisar sistemas internos para identificar dados disponíveis, sua estrutura, métodos de acesso e otimizar seu uso em sistemas e aplicações.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de sistemas que melhorem a disponibilidade de dados para a equipe do cliente.
  • Gerenciar múltiplas solicitações de alta prioridade simultaneamente, adaptando-se às mudanças de prioridades.
  • Identificar e interagir com as equipes do cliente para aprofundar o conhecimento das fontes de dados e tecnologias.
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento e aprimoramento de pipelines de dados, gerenciando novas solicitações de recursos e comunicando-se com os gerentes do cliente.
  • Desenvolver e manter plataformas para compartilhamento de dados e dashboards.
  • Criar documentação abrangente sobre fontes de dados, métodos de acesso, contatos-chave e outras informações relevantes.
  • Apresentar resultados obtidos para stakeholders em todos os níveis (técnicos e não técnicos) de forma clara e concisa.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Experiência na construção e otimização de pipelines de processamento de dados em larga escala e produção, utilizando tecnologias distribuídas.
  • Experiência na configuração e utilização de plataformas de dados baseadas em nuvem, com capacidade de provisionar e configurar recursos.
  • Experiência com Python (preferencial) ou outras linguagens para ciência de dados e análise.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e SQL.
  • Experiência com bibliotecas de análise de dados (Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Scikit-learn, etc.).
  • Experiência com bibliotecas de visualização de dados (Tableau Desktop/Server, matplotlib, seaborn, plotly, etc.).
  • Experiência na construção e otimização de pipelines de dados.
  • Experiência com frameworks de processamento de dados distribuídos (ex.: Apache Spark, Apache Flink, MapReduce).
  • Sistemas de gerenciamento de recursos e armazenamento de Big Data (ex.: HDFS, YARN; ou soluções em nuvem como S3, EMR).
  • Ferramentas de orquestração de fluxo de trabalho (ex.: Apache Airflow, Dagster, Prefect).
  • Formatos de lakehouse modernos (ex.: Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Apache Hudi).

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain) — Location: Remote — Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly).

About Innodata: Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company with more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities worldwide. We provide AI technology solutions for a wide range of industries, including financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. By combining advanced ML/AI technologies with a global workforce and a secure infrastructure, we help advance the potential of AI. Innodata offers digital data solutions and easy-to-use platforms.

Role focus : We are seeking professionals with a Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology or a closely related biomedical discipline to support the development of large language models (LLMs) in the medical domain. The role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance in medical microbiology, and providing feedback to improve AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses on topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts, evaluating the model’s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

Overview

About Pivot Bio:

Fueled by an innovative drive and a deep understanding of microbiology, genomics, crop nutrition and agriculture, Pivot Bio is pioneering game-changing advances in fertilizer technology. Our first commercial product harnesses the power of naturally-occurring microbes, modern gene editing and application technologies to provide nitrogen to crops. We are dedicated to providing new solutions for farmers to improve yield as they work to help feed the world’s growing population. Read/Hear more about Pivot Bio on Forbes or PBS News Hour.

We are seeking a Regional Commercial Agronomy Lead to manage, support, and lead a team of Commercial Agronomists on a regional level, while also providing agronomy support for an assigned portion of the region. As a key member of the Commercial team, the RCAL leads regional agronomy efforts for product performance data generation and sharing, seller agronomic and technical product training, and on-farm grower support. Pivot Bio products aim to deliver a more consistent and reliable source of nitrogen to crops and our Commercial Agronomy team strives to be industry leading nitrogen advisors. The ideal candidate will reside within this region.

Responsibilities

  • Provide regional leadership and management of Commercial Agronomists in geographical area.
  • Lead technical product knowledge, nitrogen management, customer support, and agronomy information training and development of the assigned team of Commercial Agronomists.
  • Lead commercial agronomy activites such as seller training, product demonstrations, and customer support for an assigned portion of the region.
  • Provide supplemental or next level sales and agronomy support and training for agronomists in the region. Manage current and next generation product demonstration trialing and performance data generation efforts for the region.
  • Support and facilitate commercial activities including regional product placement suggestions, regional marketing support, and regional sales staff trainings.
  • Collaborate with Regional Sales Leader on regional strategy for distribution development and sales support.
  • Lead agronomy training and trialing efforts with regional Retail distribution partners.
  • Manage key 3rd party relationships and trialing efforts within region.
  • Assist sales teams with regional sales representative trainings and customer facing events to provide technical product knowledge and agronomy support.
  • Develop and provide regional agronomy research summary materials that can be used to support product management, positioning, field sales, and training.
  • Work in partnership with the regional Product Development team to characterize and demonstrate the advantages of new commercial and pre-commercial products.
  • Collaborate with Product Development regarding product testing and validation efforts with university organizations and other third-party partnerships.
  • Regularly integrate emerging technology tools for evaluation of products as well as grower demonstrations and support.

Competencies

  • Demonstrated ability to manage and lead a team of individual contributors.
  • Strong background in agronomy or related field with a solid understanding of agricultural crops and inputs within the assigned geography.
  • Experience with fertilizer and fertility knowledge of products, applications, practices, and crop needs.
  • Fluent in understanding and ability to educate on nitrogen and nitrogen management.
  • Ability to engage/present in customer field days, meetings, as well as certain company events.
  • Strong background in field sales training with experience in technical knowledge transfer to both professional agronomists and customers or sales representatives.
  • Ability to plan, troubleshoot and evaluate product performance in customers’ fields utilizing precision software and other technology tools, such as remote sensing and aerial imagery.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This position manages a team of Commercial Agronomists within this region.

Work Environment

  • Home office based within region - this position will require travel 60% of time

Required Education & Experience

  • Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in Agronomy or related field
  • 10+ years experience in agronomy with solid understanding of agricultural crops and fertilizer inputs within the assigned geography
  • 5+ years experience in people management

Must be authorized to work in the United States

title: Médico da Família e Comunidade (RQE)
description:
Visão Geral

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Medicina e Saúde da Família e Comunidade . Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

Você realizará atendimento de orientação médica telefônica através de uma abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.

Descrição das Atividades

  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.
  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde relativos a diferentes gêneros ou grupos etários.
  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
  • Executar atividade de coordenação do cuidado, identificando situações com necessidade de encaminhamento à equipe de segunda opinião médica, comunicando-se eficientemente com os pacientes e sendo o interlocutor do caso ao gerente de segunda opinião médica.
  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

Formação Acadêmica

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO CONCLUÍDA EM MEDICINA DA FAMILIA.

Certificações

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em MEDICINA DA FAMILIA ;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).

Experiência

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em MEDICINA DA FAMILIA, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;

Competências Comportamentais

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Outros Requisitos Importantes

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

Local de Trabalho

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.

a negociar durante processo seletivo.

title: Country Operations Manager
description:
Overview

Country Operations Manager – LATAM

Job Type: Full-time contract

Trantor Inc. is a global technology services and consulting company headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with delivery centers across the USA, Canada, and India. We partner with Fortune 500 companies and high-growth enterprises to drive digital transformation through Product Engineering, Cloud Enablement, Data & AI Solutions, Automation, and Customer Success Services. At Trantor, we thrive in a collaborative, agile, and people-first environment.

Why Join Trantor?

Trantor offers the opportunity to work on diverse, cutting-edge projects in a culture that values innovation, continuous learning, and collaboration. Enjoy the flexibility of a remote role while contributing to impactful initiatives in a truly global organization.

Opportunity Summary

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Country Manager – LATAM to lead and scale our operations across the region. This role is 80% operations-focused , with responsibility for resource management, workforce planning, employee engagement, HR, HR compliance, and strategic growth . The remaining 20% requires technical acumen to manage tech people, understand how tech operations are run, and participate in technical discussions with clients.

The right candidate will have proven experience in managing, scaling, and setting up IT/Tech teams , ensuring smooth delivery and operational excellence. They must be adept at building and inspiring high-performing teams , driving compliance and retention , and cultivating trusted long-term relationships with clients and stakeholders.

What’s Exciting About This Role?

  • Lead and shape our entire LATAM operation, with the autonomy to make high-impact decisions.
  • Build and inspire a high-performing, multicultural team while forging strong client relationships.
  • Play a pivotal role in driving operational excellence and market presence.
  • Work in a fast-paced, global environment where your ideas are implemented, not just discussed.

Key Responsibilities

  • HR & Resource Management
    Oversee all LATAM resources to ensure productivity and quality.
  • Manage the full employee lifecycle including hiring, onboarding, HR compliance, and performance management.
  • Monitor attrition rates and implement proactive retention strategies.
  • Drive employee satisfaction through engagement programs, career development, and structured feedback channels.
  • Tech Operations Oversight
    Manage and scale tech operations and delivery teams.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Provide credible oversight in technical discussions with clients.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and customers across LATAM.
  • Act as the primary liaison for client needs, service delivery, and customer success.
  • Represent the company at local and regional events, forums, and client meetings.
  • Operational Leadership & Strategic Growth
    Lead daily operations, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and alignment with corporate policies.
  • Collaborate with HR, Finance, and global teams for seamless cross-functional workflows.
  • Monitor performance metrics and provide regular updates to regional/global leadership.
  • Adapt and execute market-specific strategies aligned with global objectives.
  • Financial & Market Insight Contribution
    Support budget planning, resource allocation, and cost optimization.
  • Provide local market intelligence to inform global strategic decisions.

Key Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience: 8–12 years in senior leadership or country management, preferably in the IT/Consulting sector.
  • People & HR Management: Proven success in leading teams, driving workforce planning, employee engagement, HR processes, and HR compliance , with measurable improvement in retention.
  • Tech Operations Oversight: Demonstrated ability to set up, scale, and manage IT/Tech teams (Must Have)
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Strong track record in building trusted relationships with clients, partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • Strategic & Operational Skills: Ability to translate business objectives into actionable operational and delivery plans, while ensuring compliance and efficiency.
  • Communication: Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required; Spanish and Portuguese proficiency are strong advantages.
  • Technical Tools: Familiarity with CRM systems, business management platforms, and performance reporting tools.

Why Join Us?

  • Strategic leadership role with direct impact on our LATAM operations
  • Competitive remuneration (salary only)
  • Work within a global and fast-growing organization
  • Friendly, supportive, positive, and professional team of experts
  • Multicultural and diverse environment
  • Remote work conditions

A TripleTen é uma escola de tecnologia norte-americana, reconhecida internacionalmente e premiada por sua excelência no ensino. Estamos crescendo rapidamente na América Latina, ajudando milhares de pessoas a ingressarem na indústria tech, independentemente do nível de experiência inicial .

The Opportunity
